observations.description: About the Role The Marketing Specialist is a hands-on role responsible for executing demand generation programs that drive inbound leads, engagement, and pipeline growth for Staritas . This individual will build, launch, measure, and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, web, digital advertising, social media, webinars, and other channels. The role combines demand generation with strong marketing operations capabilities, including CRM/marketing automation, campaign reporting, lead nurturing, website management, SEO, and conversion optimization. The ideal candidate is a data-driven marketer who can translate campaign performance into actionable insights and continuously improve programs to increase qualified demand and support Sales. Essential Functions Demand Generation & Campaign Execution Develop and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns designed to generate, nurture, and convert qualified leads across email, web, social, digital advertising, webinars, and other channels. Build, test, and optimize campaigns within CRM/marketing automation platforms, including emails, forms, landing pages, segmentation, workflows, lead nurturing, and calls to action. Identify opportunities to improve campaign conversion, engagement, lead generation, and funnel progression through ongoing testing and optimization. Support inbound demand generation through SEO, paid digital programs, website conversion strategies, content promotion, and other acquisition channels. Partner closely with Sales to support lead management, routing, campaign follow-up, marketing-to-sales handoffs, and progression of marketing-generated leads. Monitor email performance, deliverability, database health, and campaign engagement to continuously improve demand generation performance. Reporting & Analytics Develop and maintain CRM reports and dashboards to track marketing performance, lead generation, funnel progression, and pipeline contribution. Produce recurring performance reporting and translate results into actionable insights and recommendations. Ensure campaigns are appropriately structured and tracked to support accurate measurement and attribution. Website & Content Management System Manage and optimize the Staritas website, including webpages, content, landing pages, forms, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Perform HTML and CSS updates, troubleshoot routine website issues, and monitor website performance and conversions. Marketing Content & Operations Support the development, publishing, and quality assurance of marketing content and campaign materials. Maintain marketing data, tracking, and processes while identifying opportunities to improve and automate marketing workflows. Additional Responsibilities Other duties, as assigned Accountability Metrics Generate and contribute to established goals for inbound leads, MQLs, conversions, and marketing-influenced pipeline. Meet established deadlines for Marketing campaign deliverables with attention to detail. Contribute to planning and execution of website and campaign initiatives. Provide guidance and support for multi-channel engagement methods. Deliver metrics and campaign results monthly in a concise format. Experience 3+ years of B2B marketing or demand generation experience. Experience with CRM marketing automation, campaign execution, and reporting. Experience managing Content Management System, with working knowledge of HTML/CSS, SEO, and Google Analytics. Strong analytical, technical, and editorial skills. Education BachelorsDegree in Marketing or Equivalent Experience Required Technology Skills Marketing automation platform (example: Salesforce, Dynamics CE) Content Management System(WordPress, preferred) HTML and CSS Marketing reporting and dashboard tools Google Analytics Google Search Console Microsoft Office 365 Experience with digital advertising platforms, SEO tools, social media management platforms, webinar platforms, and other marketing technologies What We Offer Competitive salary and performance bonus program. Fully remote work environment. Comprehensive benefits package including 401k match. 19 days of PTO per year; 10 holidays per year. Opportunity to work in a mission-driven organization where your work directly shapes clarity, confidence, and better outcomes across healthcare. Travel Up to 10% travel, based on business needs. While our roles are 100% remote, we do get together a few times a year for up to one week. Employees are given ample notice and attendance is expected. Work Environment This position operates in a professional work environment and requires the use of standard office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, webcam, and phone. Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Statement Staritas is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status. As a federal contractor, Staritas complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding nondiscrimination and affirmative action. We are committed to creating a workplace that is fair, inclusive, and grounded in merit-based decision-making. Accommodation Statement If you need reasonable accommodation to apply for this position, please contact the recruiter. Pay Transparency Statement Staritas posts compensation ranges and benefits for all open roles. The compensation range for this position is$90,000 - $110,000, plus a comprehensive benefits package. Compensation offered will depend on factors including experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity. Staritas does not retaliate against employees or applicants for discussing compensation. Benefits Statement Staritas offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our employees. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plans with company contributions; paid time off and company holidays; paid parental and family leave; and access to employee assistance and wellness resources. Additional benefits include life and disability insurance, professional development opportunities, and flexible work arrangements. Learn more about us by visiting www.staritas.com. observations.description: The Web Design Specialist plays an important role in the organization by performing a number of activities directly related to the company’s marketing functions. The role is primarily responsible, under moderate to intermittent direction, for the conceptual development, direction, delivery, buy-in, and production of visual design. Key Responsibilities Design digital materials including websites, landing pages, microsites, email campaigns, and social media assets. Create user-centered, conversion-focused UX/UI designs for responsive web and marketing experiences. Translate business goals, audience insights, and marketing objectives into intuitive and engaging digital solutions. Apply conceptual thinking and design strategy to develop creative concepts based on user needs, market research, and technical constraints. Present design concepts, rationale, and solutions clearly to stakeholders and secure buy-in when required. Collaborate with designers, copywriters, project managers, and front-end developers to deliver cohesive digital experiences. Work within CMS environments (WordPress preferred) to design and support digital implementations. Assist with front-end development for small projects when necessary and collaborate closely with development teams. Design and test HTML email campaigns to ensure deliverability and cross-client compatibility. Maintain consistent brand standards across all digital touchpoints and create supporting style guides or brand guidelines when needed. Apply responsive design and accessibility (ADA) best practices across digital experiences. Manage creative workflows including file organization, version control, and design approval processes. Meet with internal stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify project goals, and deliver creative solutions within agreed timelines. Stay informed on emerging UX/UI, web, and digital marketing trends and propose process improvements to enhance team efficiency and asset adoption. Provide guidance and creative input to team members to foster strong collaboration and high-quality outcomes. Design print materials as needed to support broader marketing initiatives. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise WordPress Pardot (preferred; similar tools acceptable, but Pardot experience is ideal) Unbounce (or similar landing page tools) Figma Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) HTML, CSS, JavaScript Familiarity with Adobe Workfront is a plus Canva knowledge is optional but nice to have Benefits Above market salary HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents Government-mandated benefits Performance-based Incentives Quarterly Company Events 1,000 PHP De Minimis Equipment and software provided Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About You You are a visually driven Web Designer who enjoys transforming product requirements, user needs, and brand direction into polished, engaging digital experiences. You have a strong eye for visual hierarchy, typography, composition, spacing, and detail, while understanding how your design decisions translate across responsive products and different digital touchpoints. You are comfortable taking ideas from early visual exploration through high-fidelity, development-ready designs, working within established design systems and brand standards. You collaborate effectively with product, UX, and engineering teams, bring consistency to complex digital experiences, and maintain a high bar for visual quality, usability, and execution. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience. 4+ years of professional experience in web, visual, UI, or digital experience design. Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality visual and interface design for responsive digital products. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, styles, libraries, and interactive prototypes. Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, color, composition, spacing, and layout. Experience designing responsive experiences for web, mobile, and different screen sizes. Ability to translate product requirements, user needs, and brand guidelines into polished visual solutions. Experience creating wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and development-ready design specifications. Experience working with design systems and reusable component libraries. Understanding of usability and accessibility best practices. Experience collaborating with Designers, Product Managers, Developers, and business stakeholders. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities Design visually polished and intuitive experiences for web, mobile, and kiosk platforms. Translate business requirements, product direction, and user needs into engaging interface designs. Develop concepts from initial visual exploration through high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes. Apply brand standards and established design-system components consistently across digital products. Create responsive layouts for multiple devices, screen sizes, and interaction models. Collaborate with Product, UX, Engineering, and business stakeholders to refine requirements and design solutions. Prepare design specifications, assets, interaction guidance, and documentation for development teams. Participate in design critiques and incorporate feedback while maintaining a strong visual perspective. Review implemented experiences and address inconsistencies between approved designs and the final product. Support multiple teams and initiatives while managing priorities, deadlines, and feedback effectively. Help improve shared patterns and reusable components when recurring design needs are identified. Ensure designs meet usability, accessibility, consistency, and quality standards. Note: Figma is the primary design tool for this role. AI-based design tools are not currently part of the approved workflow. 4+ years of Web, Visual, UI, or Digital Experience Design. Strong portfolio showcasing polished responsive web and mobile interfaces. Advanced hands-on proficiency with Figma. Strong visual design fundamentals and responsive design experience. Experience with design systems and development-ready design handoffs. Advanced English proficiency. About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo , talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: You will be joining Qualified Leads as our dedicated GEO and AI Search Specialist, responsible for the technical and strategic delivery of Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) across a focused portfolio of key client accounts. In addition, a portion of your time will be allocated to supporting GEO Roadmap georoadmap.ai) — a B2B SaaS platform built exclusively for marketing agencies, developed by the Qualified Leads team. GEO Roadmap automates AI-readiness audits, discovery sessions, and strategy roadmap generation for agencies and their clients. Your deep domain knowledge makes you an integral part of this product’s growth and operations. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role ideal for someone who thrives on deep technical work, structured strategy, and the fast-moving world of AI search. You will work closely with the founders across both businesses. Time Allocation Qualified Leads (approx. 80%): GEO implementation and strategy across 5–6 key client accounts. GEO Roadmap (approx. 20%): Platform support, agency customer success, outreach reply management, and product QA. These percentages are indicative at the time of hire and will evolve as both businesses grow. As GEO Roadmap scales, the time allocated to the platform is expected to increase. Allocation will be reviewed collaboratively on a regular basis and agreed in advance of any material change. Two Businesses, One Role: A unique opportunity to be embedded across a growing agency and a SaaS product from the ground up. You will have genuine influence on both. Quality Over Quantity: Handle fewer clients than traditional agencies, allowing for deep immersion and high-standard execution. Remote Flexibility: Fully remote role with flexibility of hours for candidates who consistently deliver high-standard results. Growth Trajectory: As GEO Roadmap scales, this role grows with it. We promote from within and are actively building a small international team. Leadership opportunities are a genuine outcome, not a talking point. A New Discipline: GEO is one of the fastest-moving areas in digital marketing. You will be at the forefront of it, with the tools, resources, and backing to build real expertise. Qualified Leads Responsibilities Independent Auditing: Conduct comprehensive technical and content audits of websites and brand footprints to identify gaps in crawlability and AI citability. Strategic Planning: Prepare detailed GEO/AEO work plans and roadmaps, broken down into actionable tasks with precise hourly estimates. Full-Scale Implementation: Execute the full lifecycle of the strategy, including: Technical SEO: Optimising site architecture, core web vitals, and mobile-first performance. GEO & Schema: Implementing advanced structured data and entity-based optimisations to ensure AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) accurately parse and cite client content. WordPress / Elementor Management: Directly managing and optimising landing pages and site structures within our preferred tech stack. On-Page & Natural Language Optimisation: Formatting content for featured snippets and natural language queries. Analysis and Reporting: Produce high-quality, slide-based reports for Account Managers. Measure impact through both quantitative data (rankings, traffic, AI citation frequency) and qualitative insights (brand sentiment in AI responses). Operational Support: Coordinate with our Creative, Development, and Business Development teams to ensure GEO/AEO best practices are integrated across all channels. Proactive Communication: Clearly communicate status updates, ask clarifying questions, and raise blockers early via Zoom and internal systems. GEO Roadmap is a three-step SaaS tool built for marketing agencies: an AI-powered website audit, an AI-led discovery session, and an automated 10-page strategy roadmap. Your role across the platform includes: Agency Support: Managing inbound support enquiries from agency customers via our support system. You will be the first line of response, resolving issues or escalating appropriately. Warm Outreach Replies: Handling replies from cold email sequences via Instantly. When agencies respond with interest, you will conduct the initial conversation before escalating to the founder. Platform QA: Testing audit outputs, discovery session flows, and generated roadmaps to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency before and after product updates. Domain Approval Queue: Reviewing and approving agency domain registrations as part of our verified-access onboarding model. Product Feedback: Documenting bugs, UX issues, and feature requests from agency customers and feeding these back to the development team in a structured format. Strategy Contribution: Contributing to ongoing product and go-to-market decisions based on your frontline experience with agencies and deep understanding of the GEO landscape. Incident Communication: In the event of platform issues outside NZ business hours, acting as a first point of contact to communicate status to affected agencies and escalate to the technical team. GEO & AI Search Expertise: Deep understanding of how LLMs and Answer Engines retrieve and cite information, with a genuine passion for staying ahead of AI search developments. Technical SEO Mastery: Proven experience with technical site audits, indexation management, schema implementation, and site performance optimisation. WordPress & Elementor: Highly proficient in building and optimising within WordPress and Elementor environments. Customer-Facing Communication: Confident and professional in written communication with agency-level clients. Able to handle support and outreach conversations with credibility. Strategic & Process-Driven: Comfortable preparing structured work plans and operating independently with minimal supervision. Detail-Oriented: Focused on the finer details of technical audits, QA processes, and data accuracy. Strong English Communication: Fluent in written and spoken English, with a proactive communication style. Google Tag Manager: Experience with conversion tracking and event monitoring to support SEO data. HubSpot: Knowledge of HubSpot CRM as it relates to lead generation and contentvintegration. Project Management Tools: Experience collaborating via platforms such as ClickUp. SaaS or Product Experience: Familiarity with SaaS platforms, product feedback processes, or customer success workflows. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Job Description Title: Growth Marketing Manager – Testing & Certification EMEA Location: Remote Department: Marketing Reports To: Growth Marketing Director Division: Technical Services About FoodChain ID FoodChain ID is a global leader in food safety, quality, sustainability, and regulatory compliance solutions. Through our Testing & Certification division, we help businesses across the food and related industries demonstrate compliance, manage risk, protect their brands, and build trust throughout their supply chains. Our Testing & Certification division in EMEA provides a broad portfolio of laboratory testing, inspection, auditing, and certification services, supporting customers in meeting regulatory, industry, retailer, and customer requirements across diverse markets. As we continue to strengthen and grow our presence across the region, we are seeking a Growth Marketing Manager to drive demand generation, pipeline growth, and lead conversion across our Testing & Certification business in EMEA. About the Role We are looking for a commercially-minded, data-driven Growth Marketing Manager to lead demand generation and marketing activation activities. Working closely with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Business Unit leaders, and external agency partners, you will be responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, accelerate pipeline growth, and contribute directly to revenue targets. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and performance optimisation. You will play a critical role in translating go-to-market strategies into measurable marketing programs while ensuring leads are effectively nurtured, managed, and converted through the funnel. The successful candidate will bring strong experience in activation strategy, marketing automation, campaign management, lead lifecycle management, and multi-channel campaign execution. Key Responsibilities Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth Develop, execute, and optimise multi-channel demand generation campaigns to drive Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), pipeline, and revenue. Create and implement strategic marketing plans aligned to growth targets across the division and aligned territories. Build and manage lead nurture programs that accelerate prospect progression through the buyer journey. Campaign Strategy & Execution Partner closely with Product Marketing to translate go-to-market strategies, customer insights, and buyer personas into effective campaigns. Execute integrated marketing campaigns across email, paid media, webinars, events, website, 3 rd party media, and social. Coordinate campaign assets, messaging, and activation plans across multiple stakeholders. Collaborate with external agency to execute paid media, trade media, digital advertising, and lead generation programs. Partner with the Events team to support a global calendar of trade shows, conferences, webinars, and industry events. Marketing Automation & Lead Management Own MQL processes and lead management across the Technical Services EMEA division. Build and manage Salesforce campaigns, ensuring accurate campaign attribution and reporting. Use Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement) to create and manage email campaigns, engagement studio nurture programs, automated lead workflows and segmentation. Performance Measurement & Optimisation Track, analyse, and monitor key metrics including MQL generation, lead-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline contribution and campaign ROI. Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Establish testing frameworks for continuous optimisation of messaging, channels, and audience targeting. Qualifications & Experience Required 3+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Demand Generation or Digital Marketing within a B2B environment. Proven track record of delivering measurable pipeline growth and lead generation results. Hands-on experience with Salesforce campaign management and reporting. Strong experience using Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), including Engagement Studio and automation workflows. Experience managing external marketing agencies and paid media programs. Analytical skills with experience interpreting campaign and funnel performance data. Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within a matrixed, global organisation. Desirable Experience marketing SaaS, technology, regulatory, data, or digital solutions. Experience supporting multiple business units or product portfolios. Experience with Google Analytics, WordPress, and AI-enabled marketing tools and technologies. Additional : Occasional travel may be required to support business meetings, tradeshows, customer events, and team collaboration activities. Originally posted on Himalayas

As a Senior Production Engineer, you will lead a team of engineers utilizing an Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mentality to craft, build, and maintain complex systems at scale. You will be an essential part of taking our platform to the next level both in scale and functionality. Our production infrastructure is a hybrid environment utilizing virtual machines, containerization, and serverless technologies that hosts hundreds of thousands of customer websites, reaching a significant portion of the world's population. If you find solving complex problems irresistible, enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for delivering an elite customer experience, you may be the engineer we are looking for. Infrastructure Management: Monitor, alert, investigate, and resolve production infrastructure challenges across public cloud environments (including GCP and AWS). Automation & Optimization: Actively identify opportunities and implement automated, scalable solutions to optimize code and operational tasks, reducing toil across the platform. Incident & Problem Management: Serve as a technical point of contact during critical issues, facilitate cross-functional communication, track alert trends, and perform root cause analysis (RCA) to drive structural improvements. Change Execution: Execute production change and security requests, safely managing code deployments and patching pipelines. Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering Management to align technical solutions and execution strategies with business goals and roadmap priorities. System Design: Strong history of system architecture, distributed microservices, and self-healing systems with efficient resource and network utilization. Cloud & Containerization: Advanced expertise executing containerized workloads using Kubernetes orchestration and Docker across public cloud hosting providers. Programming Languages: Proficient in structural and automated scripting using object-oriented languages, with strong experience in Python and Go preferred. Observability: Hands-on familiarity implementing metrics, monitoring, and alerting systems (such as Prometheus or EFK stacks) to maximize infrastructure visibility. Mindset: A forward-thinking learner with superb analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis capabilities who loves a team-first environment. In this role, you will build, refine, and maintain core features across the full stack, delivering high-performance, pixel-perfect web applications while developing secure back-end systems and intuitive user experiences. observations.description: Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society. As the Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will provide the technical leadership for a large and complex web ecosystem, including approximately 140 WordPress sites supporting our Grassroots workstream as well as our Drupal properties. This is a working leadership role. You will stay hands-on in the code while owning technical strategy, architecture, engineering standards, technical discovery and estimation, mentoring, work allocation, and the partnership with Product and stakeholders. You will provide technical leadership across both our WordPress and Drupal platforms, beginning with the Grassroots workstream and extending across additional workstreams and technology stacksover time. How You Will Contribute Own architecture across the web ecosystem, including hosting and infrastructure strategy, integrations, and long-term platform direction. Stay hands-on. A meaningful share of your time is spent building, reviewing, and debugging alongside the engineers you lead. Own deployment and release processes, CI/CD, and automation, including plugin and dependency update automation. Own plugin, dependency, and security management across the portfolio, and set the patching and remediation cadence. Establish engineering and QA standards in partnership with our SDET team. Lead technical discovery and estimation, and give Product credible estimates, dependencies, risks, and technical context they can prioritize against. Participate in Product discovery where technical assessment is required, while Product retains responsibility for business prioritization. Manage stakeholder expectations and appropriately challenge requests, including saying when a commitment is not realistic and what the alternative is. Improve the triage, allocation, and sequencing of engineering work across the workstream. Mentor and develop engineers, and reduce key-person dependencies through documentation, knowledge sharing, and deliberate coverage. Develop a 12 to 24 month strategy for consolidatingor migrating appropriate WordPressand Drupal sites, and sequence that work against ongoing campaign demand. Identify opportunities to extend technical leadership across additionalworkstreams and technology stacks. What You Will Bring Eight or more years of professional software engineering experience, including time as a technical lead, staff engineer, or engineering lead for a team or portfolio. A track record of remaining heavily hands-on while leading. This is not a management role with occasional coding. Strength in architecture and systems thinking across an ecosystem of applications rather than a single site. Sound technical judgment under pressure, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder. Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineers, including senior individual contributors. Supervisory experience, including directly managing engineers, setting performance expectations, and conducting performance reviews. Reliable estimation, and the habit of surfacing risks, dependencies, and sequencing needs early. Comfort participating in product discovery and challenging requests respectfully while maintaining the relationship. Deep, current WordPress experience: custom themes and plugins, the block editor (Gutenberg), Advanced Custom Fields, WP-CLI, and multisite or large multi-site portfolios. Deep, current Drupal experience: custom modules and themes, Drupal 10 or later, the entity and configuration management systems, Views, Drush, Composer-based site builds, and headless or decoupled Drupal using JSON:API or GraphQL with a JavaScript front end. Strong modern PHP, including object-oriented design and Composer. Experience with SQLa must, including query performance work. Experience with front-end JavaScript (NextJs, React, etc) and modern build tooling. Experience owning hosting, deployment pipelines, and environment configuration for production web platforms. Strong CI/CD and DevOps skills: building and maintaining automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable), infrastructure as code, containerization, environment and secrets management, and monitoring, logging, and alerting for production systems. Experience and general knowledge of SSL certificates, DNS, and web protocols. Upsun, AWS, and Cloudflare or comparable CDN experience preferred. Experience consolidating, migrating, or reducing a site portfolio preferred. Accessibility experience to WCAG 2.2 AA preferred. Experience working with marketing and campaign teams on tight timelines preferred. Track record of using AI-enabled tools and practices to accelerate your work. Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together 's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect. What We Offer Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace. A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,400 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges. Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents. Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation. We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: We're looking for a Sales Closer to run sales calls and proposals alongside an existing sales partner at a senior-only digital studio that builds high-performance websites and digital platforms for clients across higher education, government, aerospace, healthcare, and eCommerce. This is a closing role. You will be joining an existing sales motion, not building one from scratch. You will run discovery and closing calls, prepare and present proposals, and own the final stages of the sales cycle from qualified lead through signed contract. The studio has a strong track record, a differentiated positioning, and a clear value proposition — your job is to present it compellingly and close. If you have strong B2B sales experience in digital services, agencies, or web development, can hold your own in a consultative sales conversation with sophisticated buyers, and take genuine ownership of closing outcomes, this role is a strong fit. Why You'll Want to Join You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th) Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy Observance of Holidays per company guidelines 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive This role requires availability during US business hours Join a well-established digital studio with 350 or more projects shipped and a strong client roster across multiple verticals High-ownership closing role with direct impact on revenue and business growth What You'll Work On Sales Calls and Discovery Run discovery and closing calls with prospective clients across higher education, government, healthcare, aerospace, and eCommerce verticals Understand client needs, goals, timelines, and budget parameters quickly and accurately Articulate the studio's differentiated value proposition with confidence and clarity Handle objections professionally and guide prospects through the decision-making process Proposals and Presentations Prepare and present fixed-fee proposals tailored to each client's scope and requirements Coordinate with the existing sales partner to ensure proposals are accurate, on-brand, and delivered within the studio's two business day turnaround commitment Follow up on open proposals and move stalled deals forward Pipeline and CRM Management Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all active opportunities in the CRM Track pipeline stage, next steps, and close probability across all active deals Report on sales activity and pipeline health consistently Collaboration and Handoff Work alongside the existing sales partner to coordinate on shared accounts and ensure a consistent client experience Hand off closed accounts to the delivery team with full context on scope, expectations, and client communication history Stay informed on the studio's service offerings, technical capabilities, and current client work to speak credibly about what the team can deliver What You Bring Proven B2B sales or business development experience with a track record of closing deals in digital services, web development, agencies, or a related field Comfortable running consultative sales calls with sophisticated buyers including directors, VPs, and procurement teams at universities, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and enterprise companies Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional, confident, and non-pushy closing style Experience preparing and presenting service proposals or statements of work Organized and detail-oriented with clean CRM habits and strong follow-through on open opportunities Self-directed with the ability to manage a pipeline independently without needing a sales manager to chase every deal Nice to Have Experience selling web development, digital transformation, or technology services Background selling into higher education, government, healthcare, or aerospace verticals Familiarity with accessibility standards, Webflow, WordPress, or Drupal as a sales context Experience working alongside an existing sales partner or within a small sales team Prior experience in a digital agency or professional services environment How to Apply Please include: Your updated resume A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your B2B sales experience in digital services or agencies, and walking through how you approach a closing call when a prospect is on the fence Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process. If you are a confident, consultative closer with B2B digital services experience and want to own the final stages of the sales cycle for a studio with a strong track record and a clear value proposition, this role gives you the pipeline and the direct impact to do your best work. Application Process Overview Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients: Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable) Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Title: Content Marketing Manager Location: Remote, US-only About InMarket Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today’s top brands. Through InMarket 's data-driven marketing platform, brands can build targeted audiences, activate media in real time, and measure success in driving return on ad spend. InMarket 's proprietary Moments offering outperforms traditional mobile advertising by 6x.* Our LCI attribution platform, which won the MarTech Breakthrough Award for Best Advertising Measurement Platform, was validated by Forrester to drive an average of $40 ROAS for our clients. *Source: Wordstream US Google Display Benchmarks for Mobile Media About the role Are you a great writer who knows how to make people stop scrolling? InMarket is looking for a Content Marketing Manager who can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling content that people actually want to read. We’re looking for someone who understands what makes a strong LinkedIn post, can write a hook that grabs a busy marketer’s attention, and can take a technical AdTech product or industry insight and turn it into a blog post, report, or story that connects with customers.You’ll help shape InMarket ’s voice across LinkedIn, blogs, thought leadership, case studies, research, and more. You’ll have the opportunity to experiment, develop a point of view, see what resonates, and continuously improve. You don't need to be an AdTech expert on day one. You do need to be curious, a strong writer, and excited to learn. Your Daily Impact as a Content Marketing Manager: Write compelling LinkedIn posts, blogs, thought leadership, case studies, and customer-facing content. Develop strong hooks, headlines, and narratives that capture attention and make complex ideas easy to understand. Translate product launches, research, data, and industry trends into content that is relevant and valuable to our customers. Help develop InMarket ’s voice and point of view across channels. Experiment with different content formats, topics, and messaging to understand what resonates. Use performance data and audience feedback to continuously improve our content. Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Marketing to uncover stories and ideas worth telling. Support the development of InMarket Insights reports, white papers, infographics, and other thought leadership. Manage and maintain our content across social, web, email, and other channels. Use AI as part of your workflow to research, brainstorm, draft, edit, and accelerate content creation, while maintaining a strong human point of view. Your Experience & Expertise: 2–4 years of experience in content marketing, editorial, copywriting, journalism, communications, or a related field. B2B experience is a plus, but great writing matters more than industry pedigree. Experience writing for LinkedIn, blogs, newsletters, or other digital channels. Experience with AdTech, MarTech, SaaS, data, media, or technology is a plus—not a requirement. Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day creative or research workflow is a plus. Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, WordPress, Sprout Social, Salesforce, or similar platforms is helpful but not required. Benefits Summary Competitive salary, stock options, flexible vacation Medical, dental, and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Company Matched 401(k) Unlimited PTO (Within reason) Talented co-workers and management Agile Development Program (For continued learning/professional development) Paid Paternity & Maternity Leave For candidates in California, Colorado, and New York City, Illinois, Minnesota, New Jersey, Vermont and Massachusetts the targeted base salary range for this role is $75,000 -$85,900. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to work experience, specialized skills and training, performance in role, business needs, and job requirements. Base salary is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Base salary is just one component of InMarket ’s total rewards package that also may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Ask your recruiter for more information! At InMarket , diversity is not just a value, it’s the very essence of who we are. It’s about recognizing and celebrating the unique perspectives each of us brings, from our colleagues to the communities we serve.We are committed to embracing the full spectrum of backgrounds, beliefs, abilities, and life experiences, knowing that this diversity strengthens us. At InMarket , our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion means valuing each individual’s unique contributions. Together, we thrive. InMarket is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. observations.description: WORK OPTION: Remote This is a temporary position with an expected duration not to exceed (10) months. Position Summary: This position is responsible for publishing and programming content within the NBA ’s digital channels, including the NBA App (mobile & connected devices), NBA .com, newsletters, push notifications and more. You must be a passionate fan of the NBA , have experience using editorial judgement at a high level and be an experienced digital product consumer, knowing what content experience works best for a basketball fan. Major Responsibilities: Creating world-class storytelling in a variety of formats, using text, curation and narrative to uplift visual (video, image, graphic) content Curating trending social, news and media content around the NBA quickly, and producing compelling news content from it Building, publishing and programming vertical stories within the NBA App and NBA .com with a primary focus around games and game-related content. Content sourced will be videos, photos, text and graphics Writing copy for vertical stories, as well as titles & descriptions on videos, articles and featured placements across NBA digital channels. Must be able to follow blended AP and NBA style guides Communicating with team members across various assignments. Must know when to ask questions, be engaged and when to take the lead on specific responsibilities Work with members of the Social & Digital Content Team to create fan-centric content that resonates across digital platforms. Content can be vertical video stories, editorial articles, photos, graphics, statistical or more Using editorial judgment to identify where, how and when content should be programmed on the NBA App and NBA .com. Programming decisions should be rooted in data and a firm understanding of what NBA fans want from their digital channels Working closely with the Content Creation team to ensure the video-centric NBA App connected device and mobile experiences have the right content for the respective platform consumers Segmenting, building and publishing push notifications for NBA App users Supporting the NBA ’s direct-to-consumer initiatives by promoting NBA League Pass and NBA ID campaigns throughout the season Researching and introducing new content ideas and actively participating in content planning Required Skills/Knowledge: Ideally, you have experience working for another sports or media brand. Can include collegiate digital and/or social channels. Deeply knowledgeable and passionate about the game of basketball and the NBA , including players, coaches, and teams. You can go beyond naming a favorite player to telling us the most important storylines to watch. Previous experience in journalism or related field where working on deadline and editorial judgment were traits needed to succeed. Strong written skills are required, as you’ll need that for headline writing, push notifications, or text-based content (vertical stories, articles) Must have previous experience publishing within a Content Management System with WordPress and Story Teller being preferred Must know how to build and send push notifications for the NBA App. Having worked within Braze is preferred Strong communication skills are critical - especially for a remote position. You must be able to communicate with the rest of the team, other members of the department, and third-party partners on a nightly basis Knowledge of basketball analytics and the rules of the game is key Willingness to work on projects when asked and provide creative content solutions when called upon Understanding of digital and social media trends - know how people are consuming content and how that could apply to an NBA platform Education: Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications or related field preferred. Salary Range: $2,307.69/Biweekly Job Posting Title: Project Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; short-term disability; mental health coaching/therapy; and sick time. Eligibility Note : Not all positions are eligible for these benefits; eligibility may vary by role. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. The NBA is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace. To safeguard our employees and their families, our visitors, and the broader community from COVID-19, and in consideration of recommendations from health authorities and the NBA ’s own advisors, any individual working onsite in our New York and New Jersey offices must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. The NBA will discuss accommodations for individuals who cannot be vaccinated due to a medical reason or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance. About the NBA The National Basketball Association ( NBA ) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA , W NBA , NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in 60 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2024-25 season featured a record-tying 125 international players from a record-tying 43 countries. NBA Digital’s assets include NBA TV, NBA .com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2.3 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA ’s global social responsibility platform, partners with renowned community-based organizations around the world to address important social issues in the areas of education, inclusion, youth and family development, and health and wellness. observations.description: ﻿ NAXCON GmbH , located in the heart of Freiburg, is at the forefront of the German IT and engineering industry. Our experts have extensive knowledge in software and hardware development, state-of-the-art electronics, and future-oriented technologies such as artificial intelligence and virtual reality. We are not only dedicated to project work for our customers, but also intensively pursue in-house innovation projects as well as research & development. Renowned companies from a wide range of German industries place their trust in us - demonstrating the outstanding expertise and commitment of our engineers. Position : Senior Full-Stack Developer & IT Maintenance Specialist Type : Full-time/Remote Field : IT Prequalification Requirement Relevant project references are mandatory for this role. Applications will be evaluated based on how closely the submitted reference projects match the required experience areas listed below. Please make sure that each reference project clearly states which experience areas it covers. Please include previous projects related to one or more of the following areas: Ongoing maintenance, support, and/or further development of an existing live web application (not a one-time build from scratch) Backend development using Java (ideally Java 8–17) Frontend development using Vue.js, React, Angular, or any other component-based JavaScript framework Database work with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or any other relational database Use of GitLab, GitHub, or similar for version control and CI/CD pipelines Deployment or operation on a cloud or server infrastructure Installation, configuration, or maintenance of a Wiki or CMS system (e.g. MediaWiki,Confluence, WordPress) is a strong plus Work in or for a government, public sector, or regulated environment is a strong plus﻿ Formal reference letters are not required. A short, non-confidential project summary is sufficient. Project Reference Template - please use it in the applicationPlease use the following format for each relevant project: Project Reference No.: Example: Project Reference No. 1 Contracting Authority / Client: Company name and department. Internal projects within the same company are also accepted. Contract Value in EUR: Please provide an estimate if the exact value is not known or cannot be disclosed. Project Period and Duration: Example: April 2022 – May 2024 Relevant Experience Areas Covered: Project Short Description: Please explain why the project is relevant to the required experience areas. Include the following as bullet points: Brief description of the project scope and objective Relevant technical activities performed Your specific role and responsibilities Technologies, tools, protocols, or standards used Why this project is similar to the required experience areas Please do not share confidential information. A short public or non-confidential summary is enough. Technical Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related technical field. A Fachinformatiker Anwendungsentwicklung with equivalent experience is also accepted. 3–5 years of experience in full-stack web application development and/or ongoing software maintenance. Hands-on experience maintaining and further developing a live, production web application not just greenfield development. Experience working with Java backend and Vue.js or comparable component based frontend framework. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or equivalent) including design, querying, and optimisation. Previous work in a cloud-hosted or government IT infrastructure environment. Experience with MediaWiki or comparable CMS/wiki platform installation and maintenance. Prior engagement with a German public sector client is an advantage. Proficiency in Java 11, Spring Data / Hibernate, Apache Tomcat, and Gradle. Proficiency in Vue.js 3, JavaScript, and Highcharts or similar charting libraries. Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL 14 and Git/GitLab version control. Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD pipeline configuration and automated deployments. IT security awareness aligned with BSI Standard 200-1 to 200-3. Full professional proficiency in German (written and spoken) —mandatory for client hotline. Nice to Have: Experience with Cisco AnyConnect VPN or remote access in secured government environments. Knowledge of BSI IT-Grundschutz or ISO 27001. Familiarity with EVB-IT contract frameworks or public procurement processes. Oracle Java Certification or ISTQB Certified Tester. What we offer: Join a cosmopolitan and internationally mixed team: We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and cultures to contribute their unique perspectives and talents to our team. Polish your German language skills: If you are looking to improve your German language skills, we offer a supportive environment where you can practice and develop your language abilities: whether you are a beginner or an advanced speaker. Benefit from a fixed contact person from the company: We understand the importance of having a reliable point of contact within the company. That's why we assign a dedicated contact person who will provide guidance and support throughout your employment with us. Professional growth and development: With us, our engineers can immerse themselves in new industries or projects after just 1-2 years and actively transfer knowledge. Enjoy regular team events with the company: We believe in the power of team building and fostering positive relationships within the workplace. That's why we organize regular team events to promote collaboration and strengthen our team bonds. Competitive compensation package: At NAXCON, we believe that our engineers are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a comprehensive and competitive compensation package that includes a salary commensurate with experience and expertise. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About Pantheon Pantheon ’s WebOps Platform powers more than 300,000 websites for organizations including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, and Doctors Without Borders. Our platform helps developers and marketers build, manage, and scale WordPress and Drupal websites faster. The Role Our BDRs create the first meaningful connection between Pantheon and future customers. You’ll research priority accounts, find the right people, understand their business challenges, and create qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team. This is not a generic, high-volume outreach role. It’s a research-led, account-based role for someone who can turn insight into relevant conversations. You’ll use phone, email, social selling, referrals, and events to reach decision-makers and build relationships across strategic accounts. What You Need to Succeed Own a portfolio of target accounts and prioritize where to focus. Research companies, technologies, organizational changes, business priorities, and buying signals. Map stakeholders and multi-thread conversations across strategic accounts. Write and deliver concise, personalized outreach across multiple channels. Cold call prospects and lead initial qualification and discovery conversations. Understand priorities, pain points, urgency, stakeholders, and fit. Partner with Account Executives on account plans, qualification, handoffs, and next steps. Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, messaging, content, and account insights. Keep Salesforce and account intelligence accurate and actionable. Test, learn, and improve your approach based on conversion and pipeline data. How AI Fits into the Work AI is part of our modern BDR workflow. You’ll use approved tools to: Summarize account research and surface relevant signals. Prioritize accounts and contacts. Create first-pass account briefs, messaging angles, and call preparation. Analyze engagement, conversion, and pipeline progression. Improve team playbooks and repeatable workflows. AI supports your judgment—it does not replace it. You’ll verify facts, edit every message, protect confidential information, follow Pantheon policies, and never send unreviewed AI-generated outreach. How We Measure Success Activity matters, but quality matters more. We look at: Qualified pipeline sourced and accepted by Sales. Conversion from outreach to meaningful conversations and opportunities. Account engagement and multi-threading. Opportunity quality and progression after handoff. Research quality, messaging relevance, CRM hygiene, and follow-through. Consistent achievement of agreed goals. What You Bring to the Table 12+ months of experience in sales development, business development, outbound prospecting, or a related sales role. A track record of holding your role, managing goals, and improving performance. Strong account research, writing, phone, and social-selling skills. Curiosity about technology and how digital teams work. An analytical, coachable, resourceful approach. Strong organization across multiple accounts and stakeholders. Comfort using AI and sales technology thoughtfully and responsibly. A collaborative mindset and genuine interest in building a long-term GTM career. observations.description: JOB TITLE Marketing & Leasing Coordinator JOB ID SILGOL1EA INDUSTRY Commercial Asset Management, Retail Property Management, and Investments LOCATION South Africa / LATAM JOB STATUS Full Time WORK SCHEDULE Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm (PST) SALARY $3000 to $3500 per month TARGET START DATE ASAP ROLE OVERVIEW About the Client: Our client, a premier, vertically integrated commercial real estate (CRE) firm headquartered in Irvine, California, managing approximately $4 billion in assets. Their portfolio encompasses around 100 high-value retail properties across the United States, servicing nearly 1,000 commercial tenants. Led by a seasoned executive team with roots in ultra-luxury hospitality and high-volume commercial transactions, the firm operates with a boutique, highly entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture. They deeply value people over pedigree, prioritizing high emotional intelligence, street smarts, critical thinking, and a relentless drive for operational excellence. About the Role: The Marketing & Leasing Coordinator owns how the firm presents its commercial real estate portfolio and brokerage offerings to the market. Primary focus areas include maintaining property website content, creating high-end marketing collateral, managing online listing platforms, and driving scheduled outreach cadences. This is a public-facing position operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data. This role does not require access to or handling of sensitive financial or legal data. The ideal candidate brings commercial real estate design standards, high attention to detail, strong spoken and written English, and hands-on experience using web and design tools to maintain a polished brand presence. Key Responsibilities Property Marketing & Collateral Development (~50%) Collateral Creation: Build and update property flyers, leasing brochures, availability sheets, site plans, and presentation decks using brand standards. Brand & Content Freshness: Ensure every flyer in circulation is accurate, visually appealing, and updated within a 90-day cycle. Asset Management: Organize and maintain the centralized marketing asset library (logos, site plans, high-resolution photography, drone imagery, and aerials). Outreach Campaigns: Draft property email blasts, broker announcements, and social media content (e.g., LinkedIn) using pre-approved templates and content. Website & Digital Presence (~25%) Website Management: Update property pages on the company website with photos, site plans, square footages, availability statuses, and contact details. Rapid Turnaround: Publish new availability and remove leased suites within one business day of notification. Site Quality & Analytics: Perform monthly audits for broken links, outdated collateral, or stale data. Track basic site analytics, reporting monthly on traffic and inquiry volume. Web Enhancements: Collaborate on basic website improvements using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow) and AI/development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub). Listing Platform Management (~15%) Platform Ownership: Maintain active property listings across CoStar, Crexi, LoopNet, and other commercial real estate listing platforms. Listing Audits: Reconcile all external listings against master availability lists monthly to ensure 100% accuracy in photos, square footage, and property descriptions. Market Surveys & Performance: Track listing views, saves, and inquiries per property each month, maintaining a log of published market asking rates. Leasing Coordination Support (~10%) Inquiry Intake & Logging: Log every incoming broker and prospect inquiry same-day (source, property, square footage, intended use, contact details). First-Touch Responses: Acknowledge inbound inquiries using standard approved templates and route them to the internal leasing team. Pipeline Tracking: Maintain deal status trackers, logging "last touched" dates and running automated or templated follow-up cadences (at 7, 14, and 30 days). Process Documentation: Help draft and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for marketing workflows, file management, and tracking systems. . Qualifications & Skills Non-Negotiable Requirements Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Experience: Must have direct prior experience in commercial real estate marketing or administration. Candidates must understand the distinct structural, visual, and analytical formatting required for CRE collateral compared to residential real estate. Portfolio Submission: Applications will not be reviewed without a portfolio or work samples demonstrating previous commercial real estate flyers, brochures, digital marketing assets, or presentation decks. Fluent/Native English Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills are strictly required. The candidate must be able to draft polished, error-free external communications and interact seamlessly with brokers, prospects, and internal teams without communication barriers. Scope & Access Restrictions: Must adhere strictly to data privacy boundaries—operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data with zero access to tenant financials, executed leases, or economic negotiation authority. Tool & System Requirements Design & Web Tools: Hands-on experience with design platforms (Canva, Adobe InDesign) and website content management systems (WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace). Familiarity with AI workflows (Claude, ChatGPT) for content efficiency is a plus. CRE Platforms: Proficiency or quick adaptability with CoStar, LoopNet, and Crexi. Software: Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook) and SharePoint. Performance Expectations & Metrics Ac curacy: Zero published errors in square footage, availability status, or contact information. Response Speed: All inbound inquiries logged and acknowledged the same business day; website and listing platforms updated within 24 hours of notification. Collateral Standards: No circulating flyer or marketing piece older than 90 days. Reporting: Weekly pipeline summaries and monthly web/listing performance reports delivered consistently on schedule. Strict Information Access & Scope Limitations To maintain data security, this role is strictly scoped to publicly marketable information. The following access limitations are enforced via system permissions: No Access To: Executed leases, amendments, LOIs, lease abstracts, rent rolls, tenant sales, tenant financials, bank details, operating budgets, underwriting models, ownership entity records, or HR/employee records. No Economic Negotiation: No authority to quote, negotiate, or commit to financial terms (e.g., rent rates, free rent, tenant improvement allowances). All economic inquiries are transferred directly to leadership without comment. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Who We Are: Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today. A day in the life: The project manager's day revolves around managing the intake of project or task requests, assessing their scope, and assigning them to the appropriate team members based on their bandwidth and expertise. The PM provides continuous support to the team, ensuring tasks are completed on time and meet quality standards by conducting thorough QA checks before delivering them to clients. The PM maintains clear communication with both internal teams and clients, ensuring alignment on expectations and project requirements. observations.description: Full Stack Engineer – Website & Marketing Technology (Storyblok / Next.js) Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET) Contract type: Full-time Not Your Typical Workplace WorkMotion is building the infrastructure that lets companies hire, onboard and pay people anywhere in the world and we are on our way to become Europe’s #1 Employer of Record provider. Our website is one of the first things a prospect meets, and right now we're rebuilding it from the ground up: moving off WordPress/Elementor onto a modern headless stack (Storyblok + Next.js). More Than a Role We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to own that rebuild, and then own the website after it ships. This isn't a "hand it to an agency and forget it" role. You'll be the technical backbone of our marketing website and the tracking and measurement layer that sits underneath it. If you like living where clean engineering meets marketing performance, this is your seat. You'll sit inside the Marketing team and work closely with design, demand generation, and our external agency partners. Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity As a Full Stack Engineer, you will: Lead the migration from WordPress/Elementor to a headless architecture on Storyblok + Next.js: content modeling, component structure, migration of existing pages and content, and clean cut-over with no SEO regressions. Build and maintain the new website: reusable components, page templates, and a design system in code that marketers can work with confidently through Storyblok's visual editor. Own the marketing technology layer: design and maintain server-side tracking, build and manage our GTM setup (client and server-side containers), the data layer, and conversion tracking across the funnel. Keep us fast and findable: Core Web Vitals, technical SEO foundations, structured data, and performance budgets that hold up as the site grows. Handle consent and compliance correctly: integrate our consent management platform and make sure tracking respects GDPR/ePrivacy from day one, not as an afterthought. Integrate the stack: connect the website to our marketing and CRM tooling (e.g. HubSpot) and other systems via APIs. Partner with people, not just repos: translate marketing goals into technical solutions, and work alongside our design and agency partners through launch and beyond. What You’ll Bring Must-haves Strong full stack engineering: Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, with a solid grasp of headless/JAMstack architecture. Deep, hands-on headless CMS experience (ideally with Storyblok, alternatively Contentful or Sanity) and real WordPress experience — you genuinely know both worlds and can bridge them during a migration. Server-side tracking expertise — server-side GTM, data layer design, and reliable conversion tracking in a cookie-constrained, privacy-first environment. GTM mastery — tags, triggers, variables, and server containers, plus a working understanding of GA4 and consent/CMP integration. Technical SEO and web performance fundamentals — you know why a migration can quietly tank rankings and how to prevent it. Comfort working with APIs and integrating third-party marketing/CRM tools. Bonus Points If You Bring Experience running a WordPress-to-headless migration end to end. Familiarity with Vercel (or similar), CI/CD, and modern deployment workflows. A background in B2B SaaS, and an understanding of how a marketing website actually drives pipeline. Experience building design systems or component libraries that non-engineers can use safely. Not Your Typical Team… You will join a team of 7 highly talented Marketing minds who are as obsessed with growth as they are with creating memes. We’re a young, motivated, and fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just "work" together; we create together. Whether we’re sharing the weirdest corners of the internet in our #watercooler channel or pushing the boundaries of our strategy in our weekly Thursday Think Tank, we value collective brainpower and high-energy collaboration. If you're looking for a place where your wildest creative ideas are actually encouraged (and then tested against the data), you'll fit right in. The Perks of Being Here Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours. Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax. Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships. Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups! Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. At WorkMotion , we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on . We’re here to support you every step of the way! Originally posted on Himalayas

Software Engineer – Business Systems, Automation & AI Salary / Rate: Negotiable | Contract Type: Negotiable | Remote & Flexible ProcurePublic is a public-sector framework provider looking for a Software Engineer to help us modernise, streamline and further develop the technology that supports our business. We were an early adopter of Zoho One and have built much of our operation around the Zoho ecosystem and Wordpress. The platform has evolved considerably since we first implemented it, and some of our systems and processes were originally designed to overcome limitations that simply no longer exist. We now have an opportunity to rethink how we use the platform and Wordpress. The Opportunity We want someone who can understand how our business works and help us make better use of what Zoho can do today, alongside Wordpress to improve customer interaction. Our preference is always to use native functionality wherever possible , rather than unnecessarily building around it. We believe this creates simpler systems, reduces maintenance and provides better long-term compatibility as the Zoho ecosystem continues to develop. The role will involve reviewing what we already have, simplifying where appropriate and identifying opportunities to make our systems more intuitive, automated and effective. You'll have considerable scope to influence how we develop. What You'll Work On Wordpress and Zoho, this environment includes: Zoho One | CRM | Mail | Forms | SalesIQ | Books | Creator | Analytics | Writer | Sign | ZeptoMail | WorkDrive | Bookings | Meeting | Cliq Integration and compatibility across these products is central to how we operate. You'll work on projects including: Reviewing and modernising our existing Zoho architecture Replacing historic workarounds with simpler native functionality Improving workflows, automation and integrations Making our CRM more intuitive for staff Improving the design and user experience of our forms Creating better digital journeys for clients and suppliers Developing and improving integrations with GitHub, Microsoft Azure and WordPress Working with APIs and Zoho's development tools, including Deluge and Creator Improving reporting, analytics and the way information moves between applications Identifying opportunities to simplify processes rather than simply adding more technology Taking AI Further We've already integrated ChatGPT into parts of our environment, but we believe there is considerably more potential. We want to explore how AI can become genuinely useful within our day-to-day systems – assisting staff with decision-making, interpreting information, improving workflows and providing better support to our clients and suppliers. We're therefore interested in someone who is excited by the practical application of AI, rather than simply adding AI features for the sake of it. Understand a business problem before trying to engineer a solution Learn new platforms and technologies quickly Challenge existing processes constructively Find simple solutions to complicated problems Work independently and take ownership Communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues Balance innovation with reliability and long-term maintainability Most importantly, we want someone who looks at an established system and asks: “If we were building this today, would we still do it this way?” Requirements Experience Isn't Everything You don't need to be a Zoho expert when you join us . Experience with Zoho, Deluge, APIs, GitHub, Azure, WordPress, integrations or AI development would certainly be useful, but technical ability, curiosity and the capacity to learn are more important to us than years of experience. We're looking for someone who can: Understand a business problem before trying to engineer a solution Learn new platforms and technologies quickly Challenge existing processes constructively Find simple solutions to complicated problems Work independently and take ownership Communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues Balance innovation with reliability and long-term maintainability Benefits What We're Offering We're deliberately flexible about how we engage the right person. Salary / Rate: Negotiable Contract Type: Negotiable – permanent, fixed-term or contract arrangements considered Location: Remote Working arrangements: Flexible This could suit an experienced developer looking for ownership of an established business ecosystem, or an ambitious software engineer who wants the freedom to learn, experiment and make a visible difference. This isn't a role maintaining someone else's system. It's an opportunity to help us rethink it Originally posted on Himalayas
