observations.description: About North Star Network North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries. Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment. We're a multicultural and fully remote company uniting 50+ in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas. About the Role We're looking for a Content Manager (SEO) to drive organic growth across our LATAM portfolio. This is a growth role. You own the content that drives traffic and revenue across your markets: which pages get built, which keywords they target, how they're structured, how they're updated, and how they convert. Every article you sign off on should have a clear purpose: to rank and to generate revenue. You'll work across multiple LATAM geos (Panamá, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, etc.) and sites, deciding where the opportunity is and turning that into a content plan that moves rankings and revenue. Production support is part of the job, but the outcome we measure you on is performance. What You'll Own Organic traffic and keyword visibility for your markets Content-driven conversions and revenue contribution Coverage of commercial and informational keyword clusters across each geo Quality and accuracy of everything published under your markets Key Responsibilities 1. SEO Content Strategy and Keyword Research Own the content roadmap for your markets: identify gaps, prioritise clusters, and decide what gets written and when, based on search demand and commercial value. Run keyword research end to end: volume, difficulty, SERP intent, competitor coverage, cannibalisation risk, and internal linking opportunities. Map keywords to page types and build the silo structure that supports them, distinguishing money pages from supporting content. Analyse SERPs before briefing: what Google is actually rewarding for the query, which formats win, which entities and subtopics need to be covered. Turn research into briefs that a writer can execute without guesswork: target keyword and variants, search intent, mandatory sections, competitive angle, word budget, internal links, and E-E-A-T requirements. 2. Content Optimisation and Performance Growth Monitor performance in Google Search Console, rank trackers, and analytics, and act on it: identify pages losing ground, pages stuck on page two, and queries with impressions but no clicks. Build and execute a content update programme: refresh, expand, consolidate, or prune existing pages to recover and grow positions. Optimise titles, headings, on-page copy, and internal linking to improve CTR and conversion, not just rankings. Report on what's working and what isn't, with a clear read on cause and next action. 3. Editorial Quality and Brand Standards Perform the final editorial check on every piece: factual accuracy, brief adherence, SEO execution, readability, and brand voice. Verify operator, bonus, and regulatory details against primary sources. No fabricated data, no unverified claims. Enforce E-E-A-T and responsible gambling standards, and keep content aligned with the licensing and advertising rules of each LATAM market. Keep prose natural and human. Content that reads as AI-generated doesn't ship. 4. Production Coordination Brief, assign, and manage writers, ensuring the content roadmap is delivered on schedule. Keep the Asana board accurate: statuses, deadlines, briefs, assignments. 5. Cross-Functional Coordination Work with the Content Writer to hand off approved content cleanly and publish on time. Align with technical SEO team, product, and commercial stakeholders on priorities and market strategy. Basic technical SEO knowledge to identify and flag major issues, such as indexation and canonicalization problems. Escalate blockers and scheduling risks early, and contribute workflow improvements. What we're looking for Essential Proven track record growing organic traffic through content, with results you can talk through. Strong content SEO skills: keyword research, search intent analysis, SERP analysis, content structure, internal linking, content updates and consolidation. Comfortable working from data. Google Search Console is a daily tool, not a monthly export. Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar platforms, as well as AccuRanker Solid editorial judgement and a high bar for factual accuracy. Expert-level WordPress knowledge, with the ability to upload and format content, implement on-site changes, and ensure pages are correctly published and optimized. Native Spanish (LATAM) plus strong professional English. Ability to run several markets in parallel without losing track of detail. Experience with project management tools (Asana or similar) Working knowledge of technical SEO: enough to recognise and correctly flag an issue, and to brief the people who fix it. Nice to Have Experience in iGaming, sports betting, or affiliate content. Familiarity with LATAM search markets and their regulatory differences. Experience briefing and reviewing freelance contributors. What We Offer Work on a high-profile international project in partnership with a major sports media brand. Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across time zones. A fast-paced, multicultural team passionate about sports and digital media. Real ownership: your decisions show up directly in traffic and revenue. Career growth opportunities within a scaling global company. Competitive salary based on experience and seniority. Ready to Join Us? If you want a role where content strategy is judged on results rather than output volume, and you know how to turn keyword research into rankings and revenue, we want to hear from you. Apply now and help us grow across LATAM. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations. Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential. You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role). This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it. Tasks Your core mandate sits on three priorities. 1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines. Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages. Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer. Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines. 2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth. Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them. Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited. 3. Benchmark Reports and Growth This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority. Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up. 4. PPC Management and Optimization Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores. Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support. Requirements Required 5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption. Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations. Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease. Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't. Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards. A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges. Strongly Preferred Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision Experience building benchmark reports or original research content Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software Experience with PPC management and optimization Benefits About Lumiform Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform . Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance. Why working with us You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm. Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. Shape a major growth channel from scratch. Benchmark reports and AEO strategy will drive significant value for the company Work fully remote and choose where you get things done If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. Our Hiring Process Screening call (30 minutes) with HR First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes) Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step) Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Your next adventure starts at Encamp . Encamp is on a mission to create a world where good for business is good for the environment. And we’re doing it with a modern first-of-its-kind SaaS platform for environmental compliance Built by our own EHS professionals, the Encamp platform makes environmental compliance and reporting faster, easier, and more accurate by eliminating data silos and arduous technology implementations and adoption life cycles. Today, over 300 enterprise organizations trust Encamp to safeguard 40,000+ facilities. We’re an expanding team of remote-happy Encamp ers, with roots in Indianapolis but quickly expanding throughout the U.S. As a part of the Encamp team, you’ll tackle challenges of scale and complexity as we develop our product at a fast pace and continue to create the future of EHS technology. Encamp ers choose us and grow with us thanks to a company culture that supports ownership, optimizes action, and surrounds you with intelligent and supportive colleagues to continually maximize learning. About the Role As Encamp ’s Marketing Campaigns Specialist, you will be the execution engine for all integrated marketing campaigns, supporting the full marketing team across ABM plays, events logistics, demand generation, and campaign operations. This is a role for someone who is meticulous about the details, takes genuine pride in flawless execution, and is ready to grow their ABM and demand generation skills in a hands-on environment. Your primary focus will be ABM execution support — helping build and maintain account lists, supporting 1:1 landing page builds, managing LinkedIn and HubSpot campaign setup, and ensuring that account-level programs run smoothly. You will also heavily support the events program on logistics and coordination, and plug in across content and product marketing campaign needs as the team requires. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Marketing. As a Marketing Campaigns Specialist you will be responsible for: ABM execution support: assist with account list research and maintenance, contact enrollment in HubSpot campaigns, LinkedIn matched audience setup, and 1:1 landing page builds. Ensure all ABM assets are live, tracked, and error-free before and after launch. Campaign setup and operations: Work with our external contractors to set up email campaigns, landing pages, and workflows in HubSpot. Validate UTMs, confirm Salesforce campaign attribution, test all links and forms before launch, and maintain accurate contact enrollment across active programs. LinkedIn and Google Ads support: assist with audience setup, ads and messaging, budget monitoring, and performance data pulls for active paid campaigns. Flag anomalies against benchmarks and surface them to the team proactively. Events logistics support: coordinate operational aspects of webinars and field events including registration setup, vendor coordination, attendee communications, and post-event wrap-up. Support pre-event promotion and post-event follow-up nurture in Salesloft and HubSpot. Demand generation support: assist with contact segmentation, list hygiene, lead scoring maintenance, and nurture campaign setup in HubSpot under the direction of the Director of Revenue Marketing. Content and product marketing support: coordinate asset distribution, improve brand visibility by keeping our website and social accounts updated, assist with campaign launch checklists for product launches, and support content activation across channels as needed. Reporting support: pull campaign performance data from LinkedIn Campaign Manager, HubSpot, and Salesforce to support weekly reporting and check-ins. Marketing operations hygiene: ensure contacts are enrolled correctly, lists are accurate, UTMs are tracking, and attribution is set up properly across all active programs. Flag issues before they become problems. What We’re Looking For: 3+ years of B2B marketing experience. Some exposure to ABM, demand generation, or account-based programs is strongly preferred. SaaS experience is a plus. Familiarity with ABM concepts and execution. You understand how to construct a 1:1 landing page, how a matched audience works in LinkedIn, and why contact enrollment in Salesforce matters. You don’t need to have owned ABM strategy, but you need to know how the pieces fit together. Strong attention to detail. You catch broken links, incorrect dates, missing UTMs, and wrong audience segments before they go live. You double-check your work before sharing it. Strong HubSpot experience. You understand how to build emails, forms, CTAs, and lists, how to maintain data hygiene, and have set up workflows before. Experience with other tools including Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, WordPress, Storylane, Supermetrics, Salesloft, and LLMs a strong plus. Proactive communicator. You surface issues before they become problems and ask questions when something doesn’t look right. You don’t wait to be asked if something went wrong. Generalist curiosity. You’re energized by the variety of working across ABM, events, demand gen, and content — and you’re willing to go wherever the team needs you most. Growth mindset. You want to develop your ABM and integrated campaign skills, understand the strategy behind what you’re executing, and grow into more ownership over time. Comfortable with AI tools and marketing technology. You use the tools available to work smarter and are open to learning new ways of doing things quickly. Perks of being a happy Encamp er: Competitive salary and benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k match, and responsible Paid Time Off A flexible, remote-first culture with an allowance to support your remote work setup Share in our success - you’ll have a significant personal impact on the team and the ability to earn equity Parental leave - we know how important it is to spend time with your new family! Sustainable 1:1s, focused on not only your growth as an employee, but in your career Get together at in-person Encamp Summits to share our wins and build community Work with a brilliant team of people that share your values and passion Ready to join us around the Encamp -fire? Come join a team of trailblazers making a BIG difference in the environmental programs for more than 40k facilities around the United States. We’re on a mission to create a world where good for business is good for the environment. At Encamp , we believe we are better together – all of us, whatever our race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age or physical ability. We strive to create an environment that encourages and celebrates diverse voices, backgrounds, and experiences. A cornerstone of our culture is the ability to bring their full, authentic selves to work every day. Encamp is committed to unbiased hiring practices and achieving minority representation above community averages. In transparency, the base salary for this position is $70,000-90,000/yr. As part of our hiring process, Encamp may use AI-powered tools to support initial resume screening and application review. All hiring decisions are made by our People Ops and hiring teams, not by AI. If you'd prefer your application be reviewed without the use of these tools, you can email us at to opt out Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: What You Can Expect This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences. About the Team You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate. Responsibilities Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities. Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle. Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture. Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention. Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times. Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering. Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements. Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews. Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes. What We're Looking For 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes. Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs. Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance. Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change. Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes. Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders. Salary Range or On Target Earnings: Minimum: $124,000.00 Maximum: $271,200.00 In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value. Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application! Anticipated Position Close Date: 09/22/26 Ways of Working Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting. Benefits As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information. About Us Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars. We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment. Our Commitment At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step. If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed. Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. observations.description: About Pantheon Pantheon 's WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 700,000 websites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon 's multi-tenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. The Role Pantheon is seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead how Pantheon delivers monetization and billing in the product, owning the infrastructure that turns pricing and packaging decisions into what customers actually experience — and using that ownership to move the metrics that matter with a high degree of independence. You'll build and run the billing, metering, and entitlement systems that make Pantheon 's plans, tiers, and add-ons real, and use that platform to optimize what customers buy: driving upsell and expansion, and reducing downsell and churn. You'll operate with minimal oversight, owning how Pantheon delivers and monetizes through the product — including how we enable partner and agency monetization — while partnering closely with Finance, RevOps, and Sales leadership on the underlying pricing and packaging decisions. You'll also mentor other PMs working on adjacent growth and monetization initiatives. The job is measured on outcomes: NRR, expansion, and reduced churn/downsell, and on the strength of the strategy and infrastructure you build to deliver them. What You'll Do Own net revenue retention (NRR) for the WebOps Platform: drive expansion and upsell, shape how packaging and tiers show up in-product, and reduce downsell and churn Own and report on the metrics that matter: NRR, expansion revenue, and partner-sourced revenue, in partnership with Finance and Analytics Partner cross-functionally on pricing and packaging strategy across self-serve, sales-assisted, and enterprise motions, bringing data and trade-off analysis to those decisions Own the roadmap for Pantheon 's billing and metering platform (subscription billing, invoicing, usage-based pricing, entitlements) as the infrastructure that makes those pricing and packaging decisions real Keep billing, CRM, and quote-to-cash systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, and our billing platform) aligned so partner and customer pricing changes flow through cleanly to quotes, invoices, and revenue reporting Reduce revenue leakage through payment, dunning, and collections improvements Own how Pantheon enables partner and agency monetization by building the billing, discounting, and revenue-share mechanics that make it profitable for agencies to partner with us, in partnership with the Partner team, Sales, and Finance on the underlying terms Track competitive and market trends in SaaS pricing, packaging, and billing to spot new monetization opportunities for Pantheon Mentor and unblock other PMs working on adjacent growth and monetization initiatives, and champion pricing and billing best practices across the Product org Build visibility and trust for monetization and billing work across the organization — communicating strategy, outcomes, and trade-offs clearly enough that leaders across Product, Finance, and Go-to-Market can act on them What You Bring to the Table Experience 8+ years of Product Management experience, with deep expertise owning pricing, packaging, monetization, or billing at a B2B SaaS company, and a track record of driving strategic monetization initiatives with high independence Experience designing partner, channel, or reseller pricing and incentive models — you know how to structure a deal that works for both sides Direct experience owning or working closely with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Chargebee, Stripe Billing, or similar) Familiarity with usage-based pricing and metering/entitlement tools (e.g., Stigg, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar) Working knowledge of CRM and quote-to-cash tooling (Salesforce, HubSpot) and how pricing changes flow through to sales and marketing systems Demonstrated ability to design and interpret pricing experiments, and to use data (SQL, Amplitude, Looker, or similar) to inform monetization decisions Proven ability to move revenue outcomes: NRR, expansion, and reduced churn/downsell Skilled at leading cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Finance, RevOps, and Sales on monetization strategy, and comfortable operating with minimal direction Excellent verbal and written communication skills; resourceful, self-motivated, and detail-oriented Bonus Points For Experience monetizing a partner, agency, or channel ecosystem specifically Background partnering directly with Finance/Revenue Accounting on billing system migrations or ERP integrations Experience with WebOps, hosting, or the WordPress/Drupal ecosystem What We Offer We have all the usual perks and benefits, but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team. observations.description: über uns – talentspring academy group Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht? Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig transformieren KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen – schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. In nahezu allen zukunftsrelevanten Sektoren fehlen qualifizierte Fachkräfte. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren. Genau hier setzen wir an: Mit digitalen, staatlich geförderten Weiterbildungen, die Menschen beruflich neu aufstellen, Chancengleichheit stärken, digitale Kompetenzen breit vermitteln – und so den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland langfristig zukunftsfähig machen. Die Talentspring Academy Group ist ein dynamisch wachsender Verbund staatlich anerkannter digital-first Bildungseinrichtungen mit klarem Fokus auf digitale Berufsfelder. Wir qualifizieren Menschen ohne formalen Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen und Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmende für gefragte Tätigkeiten in der digitalen Arbeitswelt – staatlich zertifiziert, praxisnah und anschlussfähig. Unsere Programme qualifizieren für zukunftsrelevante Berufsfelder in Bereichen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Online Marketing und Digital Sales – flexibel gestaltet, arbeitsmarktnah und mit echten Karriereperspektiven. Was uns besonders macht: Wir verbinden die Geschwindigkeit und Innovationskraft eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite und Glaubwürdigkeit etablierter Bildungsstrukturen. Durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor verfügen wir über eine bundesweite Infrastruktur mit mehreren hundert Standorten, tiefem institutionellem Vertrauen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – über digitale wie lokale Kanäle. Das schafft Marktzugang, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Skalierbarkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld. Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann. Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei? über die rolle Du suchst eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe neben dem Studium, möchtest Deine Marketing-Kompetenz weitergeben und anderen helfen, in der digitalen Arbeitswelt Fuß zu fassen? Als Teaching Assistant (m/w/d) bist Du die zentrale Bezugsperson für unsere Teilnehmenden – motivierend, unterstützend und lösungsorientiert. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Dozierenden zusammen und begleitest die Studierenden durch ihren Lernprozess: nicht als klassische Lehrkraft, sondern als Coach, Wegbereiter:in und Sparringspartner:in auf Augenhöhe. Du hilfst Menschen dabei, ihr Leben zu verändern. deine aufgaben Lernbegleitung mit Wirkung: Du unterstützt unsere Teilnehmenden bei der Bearbeitung von praxisnahen Online-Marketing-Projekten und stehst bei Fragen als erste Anlaufstelle zur Seite – empathisch, lösungsorientiert und geduldig. Motivator:in & Strukturgeber:in: Du hilfst dabei, Lernbarrieren zu überwinden, stärkst das Selbstvertrauen der Teilnehmenden und gibst Orientierung im Lernalltag. Verständnis fördern statt Frontalunterricht: Du erklärst komplexe Inhalte einfach, hilfst bei Transferaufgaben und ermutigst zur praktischen Umsetzung – z. B. im Umgang mit Tools wie Meta Ads, Google Analytics oder Canva. Teamarbeit mit Dozent:innen : Du gibst Feedback aus der Lernrealität zurück und trägst so dazu bei, dass unsere Programme kontinuierlich besser werden. Prozesse mitgestalten: Du bringst dich aktiv in wöchentliche Team-Calls ein und hilfst mit, die Qualität unserer Programme weiterzuentwickeln. das bringst du mit Immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule – idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften, Medieninformatik oder verwandten Fächern. Erste Berufserfahrung im Online Marketing – z. B. durch ein Praktikum, eigene Projekte, Werkstudierendentätigkeiten oder Freelancing. Grundkenntnisse in CMS-Systemen (z. B. WordPress, Webflow, Typo3 oder ähnliche). Didaktisches Gespür & Geduld – Du kannst Dich auf unterschiedliche Lerntypen einstellen und Wissen klar und verständlich vermitteln. Starke Kommunikationsskills – Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1+) und überzeugst durch eine wertschätzende, klare Sprache. Empathie & Verantwortungsgefühl – Du nimmst die Sorgen und Herausforderungen der Teilnehmenden ernst und willst echten Impact erzeugen. Organisationsstärke & Selbstständigkeit – Du behältst auch in dynamischen Phasen den Überblick, arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig. Lernfreude & Digital-Affinität – Du hast Spaß an digitalen Tools und möchtest Dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Sprachliche Souveränität: Du verfügst über hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau oder C2-Level – schriftlich wie mündlich. Zusätzlich kommunizierst du sicher auf Englisch und bewegst dich souverän in einem zweisprachigen Arbeitsumfeld. Verfügbarkeit: mindestens 4 Nachmittage pro Woche von 14:00–18:00 Uhr was wir dir bieten Sinnvolle Arbeit mit echtem Impact: Du hilfst Menschen dabei, neue Perspektiven zu gewinnen – oft in einer entscheidenden Phase ihres Lebens. Remote-Option: Ob vom Schreibtisch, Café oder aus dem Ausland – wir ermöglichen orts- und zeitflexibles Arbeiten. observations.description: Please be aware of recruiting scams! All legitimate communication from our recruitment team will come from an official email address via email, we will not text you about a role you have not applied to or shown interest in. We will not perform any interviews via text or Zoom chat. CALSTART does not ask for any fees or personal information such as social security numbers or bank details during the recruitment process. About Us : CALSTART is a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all. For over 30 years, it’s been CALSTART ’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration. About The Role ​​The Web Developer will support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of CALSTART ’s portfolio of websites, helping advance our mission through accessible, reliable, and engaging digital experiences. This role will build and update web pages, develop custom website functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, improve site performance, and help ensure CALSTART ’s websites meet security, accessibility, and usability standards. Working within the Marketing Department’s Web Team and reporting to the Senior Website Manager, this position will collaborate with marketing, design, communications, program teams, and external partners to bring digital projects to life. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact websites and campaigns while supporting an organization working to accelerate clean transportation and create healthier communities.​ Duties & Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and enhance CALSTART websites, landing pages, and web applications using WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL. * Independently manage assigned CALSTART web properties, including routine maintenance, technical troubleshooting, testing, deployments, and post-launch support. * Build and modify WordPress themes, templates, reusable components, blocks, plugins, and custom functionality. * Translate approved designs and business requirements into responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web experiences that meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards. * Support website launches, redesigns, migrations, integrations, and strategic projects, including the upcoming CALSTART .org rebrand and rebuild. * Develop and maintain integrations with REST APIs, forms, analytics platforms, CRM systems, Salesforce, and other third-party services. * Collaborate with the Senior Web Developer, designers, Marketing, IT, program teams, and other stakeholders throughout planning, development, quality assurance, and launch. * Monitor and improve website performance, security, accessibility, uptime, scalability, and Core Web Vitals across CALSTART ’s web portfolio. * Maintain technical documentation and contribute to development standards, reusable components, testing practices, deployment procedures, and Web Team workflows. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, web development, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Five or more years of professional web development experience, including experience developing and maintaining WordPress websites. * Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, modern JavaScript, and building or modifying WordPress themes, templates, blocks, plugins, or custom functionality. * Working knowledge of PHP, MySQL, REST APIs, third-party web services, and Git-based development workflows. * Experience applying web accessibility standards, preferably WCAG 2.1 or newer, along with an understanding of website security, privacy, performance optimization, cross-browser compatibility, and testing practices. * Ability to independently troubleshoot issues across front-end, back-end, CMS, database, integration, and hosting environments. * Strong organizational and project administration skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments across a portfolio of websites. * Strong communication, collaboration, accountability, adaptability, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to explain technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Desired Qualifications * Experience with hosting and infrastructure platforms such as WP Engine, GoDaddy, Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Experience with Advanced Custom Fields, Gutenberg, WPBakery, or similar WordPress development tools. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, multi-environment deployment workflows, Docker, or containerized local development. * Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, marketing automation platforms, CRM integrations, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or consent-management tools. * Familiarity with React, Vue, or another modern JavaScript framework. * Experience with automated testing tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Jest, or similar technologies. * Experience supporting website migrations, redesigns, maintenance transitions, data visualizations, GIS tools, or multisite web portfolios. * Experience working within a nonprofit, public-sector, clean transportation, or other mission-driven organization. We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you. We're a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success! We care about your personal well being as much as your professional success and offer generous benefits to full time employees including: 100% company paid comprehensive health benefits for Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, Retirement plan with generous company contributions, FSA for Health and Dependent Care, 3 weeks of vacation time in the first year of employment, 11 paid company holidays, paid sick time, paid family leave, and more! Our inclusive environment focuses on making decisions based on merit without regard to race, color, hair texture, gender, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, LGBTQIA+ status, marital status, pregnancy, disability, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. observations.description: About Better Impact Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities. Our platforms help nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, volunteer centers, and corporate community programs recruit, onboard, schedule, train, communicate with, and understand the impact of their volunteers. More than 85,000 organizations across 20 countries use Better Impact today. In January 2026, Better Impact and Galaxy Digital combined to create a larger platform dedicated to volunteerism and community engagement. We are now a team of more than 100 employees and FTEs, operating across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are growing, integrating, and building the systems a company at our stage needs. That includes the People function. About HandsOn Connect HandsOn Connect is our volunteer management platform, built natively on Salesforce. Nonprofits, companies, and universities use it to recruit, schedule, track, and report on their volunteers through a branded portal that runs on their own Salesforce data. Our Team & Culture We think good software should make community work easier, not add to the pile. We are a remote team that ships carefully, shares credit, and gives people real room to grow. We welcome different backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet most of what is listed below but not all of it, apply anyway. We would rather hear from you. The Role You are the person our customers count on when something in Salesforce is not behaving, and the person who sets them up so that happens less often. The job blends hands-on Salesforce work, customer support, and onboarding. You will work directly with clients, and you will also shape how support and onboarding actually run here: the process, the training, the documentation. We are looking for someone who likes untangling a messy technical problem, likes the person on the other end of the ticket, and cannot leave a broken process alone. It is a good fit if you like to lead by doing, if you enjoy teaching and coaching, and if you are happiest when you can fix the thing and then fix the reason it broke. Core Responsibilities Customer Support Leadership. Be the escalation point for the hard ones. Work tickets alongside the team, give clear answers quickly, and set the bar for what good support looks like here. Onboarding Program and Team Lead. Own onboarding from the first call to go-live. Walk new clients through setup and configuration on a timeline that fits them, then turn what works into a repeatable process. Client Training & Resource Development. Run customer trainings and build the materials that scale them: guides, short videos, knowledge base articles. Help customers get past the basics and actually use the platform well. Retention & Expansion Support. Work with Customer Success to spot accounts that are drifting, and step in early. Use usage data and support trends to find where customers could be getting more out of the product. Team Leadership & Process Improvement. Mentor the support team and help build a function that runs well without heroics. Improve workflows, documentation, and how tickets move between people. Requirements Salesforce Technical Expertise You should have hands-on experience with: Custom object and field creation Salesforce Flow design and implementation SOQL query writing User permission management Email templates, alerts, and list views Reports and dashboards Data import/export and Translation Workbench Troubleshooting configuration and data issues What You Bring 5+ years in a customer-facing role, preferably in SaaS 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience Experience mentoring or leading people on a support, onboarding, or customer success team At least one current Salesforce certification (Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Nonprofit Cloud Consultant, or similar) Comfortable working remotely and running client calls and trainings Strong communication, documentation, and project management skills Able to juggle several priorities without dropping the thread Nice to Have Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS Experience creating customer training materials or video tutorials CMS experience (Wix, WordPress, or similar) Working knowledge of HTML, SOQL, or similar technical languages Benefits Salary Range: $85,000-$95,000 Our benefits package includes: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance (after 90 days) 401(k) (after 90 days) Unlimited PTO after 90 days, plus 9 paid holidays Paid maternity and paternity leave Fully remote work environment We review salaries every year and adjust based on your performance and how the company is doing. This is a full-time, fully remote position. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: This is a remote position. Our client is looking for a Digital Designer to join their growing creative team and support a fast-paced pipeline of marketing, digital, print, and event-related projects. They operate in the commercial real estate media, marketing, and events industry and have expanded their presence in recent years through conferences, digital content, awards programs, and creative services. This is a production-first, template-driven design role focused on supporting a high volume of event and marketing deliverables. The position is not primarily centered on developing brand identities or creating illustration-based concepts. Instead, the selected candidate will efficiently produce polished, accurate, and brand-consistent materials using established templates and visual guidelines. The designer will work across three essential areas: website and WordPress design, print production, and digital marketing design . Projects may include website graphics, HubSpot emails, advertisements, event signage, presentation decks, award graphics, social media content, brochures, programs, and large-format materials. During certain production cycles, the designer may create 50 to 100 variations of an approved asset , such as award graphics, while maintaining consistency across names, dimensions, formatting, and export specifications. They will also support multiple events at different stages of development, moving between early concepts, production-ready materials, and frequent revisions throughout the day. The ideal candidate combines strong typography and layout judgment with the speed, organization, and attention to detail required for high-volume production work. They should be comfortable taking ownership of assignments, managing shifting deadlines, and asking thoughtful questions when instructions or specifications require clarification. Responsibilities Design digital marketing assets, including online advertisements, social media graphics, website banners, campaign visuals, promotional materials, and branded content. Create, update, and format website graphics and landing-page content within WordPress. Build and format marketing emails, campaign templates, and supporting creative assets in HubSpot. Produce print-ready materials such as flyers, brochures, event programs, posters, signage, sponsorship materials, and large-format graphics. Develop professional PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks, sales-support documents, and conference-related presentations. Produce high volumes of template-based assets while maintaining visual consistency, accuracy, and brand alignment. Create award graphics and other repetitive deliverables that may require 50 to 100 customized variations during a single production cycle. Support conferences and events with speaker materials, event branding, promotional graphics, signage, programs, sponsorship assets, and on-site visual materials. Maintain established brand standards across digital, print, website, email, presentation, and event communication channels. Prepare, organize, package, and export production-ready files according to the correct specifications for professional printing and digital publishing. Collaborate with marketing, editorial, content, events, sales, and leadership teams to execute campaigns and internal initiatives. Review all deliverables for typography, alignment, spacing, spelling, dimensions, consistency, formatting, and technical accuracy. Requirements 3 to 5 years of professional experience in graphic design, digital design, marketing design, production design, or a related creative role. Demonstrated professional experience across all three of the following areas: Website design and WordPress Print design and production Digital marketing design Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator. Practical experience updating, formatting, and publishing website content through WordPress. Professional experience building or formatting marketing emails in HubSpot. Ability to demonstrate HubSpot email-building experience through portfolio samples, work examples, or a detailed discussion during the interview process. Strong production-design capabilities, including the ability to create large quantities of template-based assets accurately and efficiently. Experience preparing artwork and production files for commercial printing, digital publication, and large-format output. Excellent typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and layout skills. Ability to manage several assignments and event timelines simultaneously. Comfort working with frequent revisions, changing information, and short production deadlines. Professional portfolio demonstrating digital, print, website, email, and layout-driven design work. Qualifications Experience creating event-related materials such as award graphics, conference programs, speaker graphics, signage, sponsorship materials, and large-format designs. Strong understanding of email-layout best practices and the visual requirements of responsive email campaigns. Familiarity with basic HTML concepts used for email formatting and troubleshooting. Previous experience within commercial real estate, media, publishing, conferences, events, marketing, or an agency environment. Experience designing PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks, proposals, or sales-support materials. Strong understanding of production workflows, file naming, version control, and export requirements. Ability to follow established creative direction while recognizing when a layout requires refinement. A design approach centered on typography, structured layouts, clear hierarchy, and generous use of white space. Ability to use large decorative elements selectively rather than allowing them to overpower the layout or message. A portfolio that prioritizes graphic design, typography, layout, and production-ready execution rather than illustration, character design, or decorative artwork. Benefits Full-Time Position 100% Remote Opportunity Work with an established and growing organization Collaborative and creative work environment Opportunity to contribute to high-visibility projects and campaigns Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Automattic for Agencies, the agency partnerships division of Automattic , is seeking a motivated Senior Partner Manager to join the team. You’ll manage and develop relationships with our most strategic agency partners, with a significant focus on driving WordPress VIP (WPVIP) revenue. As a Senior Partner Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a portfolio of partners and driving VIP product enablement and adoption. This includes onboarding and strategizing with new strategic agencies, as well as creating and delivering strategic plans that achieve mutual growth for VIP and our partners. You will use your extensive experience as a Partner Manager to drive partner development, renewals, and seek new opportunities within an account. As a Senior Partner Manager, you'll be responsible for: Driving sales of Automattic products through partner channels with digital agencies, identifying new opportunities for revenue generation. Building and maintaining strong relationships with a book of Premier partners, supporting partners through their whole journey, from onboarding to expansion, by understanding their business strategy and needs. Developing and executing on high-impact strategies for partner retention, net revenue retention, and partner growth. Representing Automattic and building awareness of our products and services in the partner’s organization via a one-to-many approach with partners. Communicating often with key stakeholders within WordPress VIP, as well as other business units, on the needs, alerts, and statuses of partner relationships. Become the agency’s trusted advisor, helping them to build strong WordPress VIP business practices, deliver successful projects, and scale their own growth via Automattic for Agencies and VIP. Provide training and support to partners to enhance their understanding of Automattic 's products, services, and value propositions. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external Business Unit (BU) teams, including Marketing, Sales/CS, Happiness, Product, and Executive Leadership. Collaborate on marketing and sales enablement programs for partners with respective BUs. Attend and support flagship WordCamps, explore potential sponsorships, and participate in partner events to drive lead generation and enhance brand visibility. Gather feedback from partners to improve products, services, and the overall partnership experience. Advocate for partner needs within Automattic or the partner’s respective BU niche. Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments. Use market insights to refine partnership strategies. Ensure partners adhere to agreed-upon standards and compliance requirements. Seek ways to enhance the overall partner ecosystem within Automattic . You’re thrilled about this opportunity because you have: 8+ years of experience as a Partner Manager, Relationship Manager, Customer Success Manager, or Account Manager at a technology or media company (SaaS preferred). Expertise in managing a high-volume portfolio of partners, and meeting/exceeding Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and growth goals. Experience working with Global System Integrator/System Integrator organizations to build new alliances, introduce technology practices, maintain and scale them. Demonstrated experience communicating and negotiating with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders within partner accounts and internally. Outstanding communication. You should be great at holding people’s attention, whether presenting, talking on the phone, or writing a quick blog post. Dynamic Presentation Skills: adept at presenting to individuals and groups, including C-level executives, in person or virtually. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal and external teams. Ecosystem Familiarity: experienced with Automattic ’s brands and vast product suite within the WordPress ecosystem, as well as other key brands and third-party products/solutions that agencies leverage, such as hosts, dev tools, etc. Ability to grasp and communicate technical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally to build relationships with partners at events such as flagship WordCamps. Adaptable to new technologies, industry trends, and changes in the competitive landscape. Salary range: $125,000-$180,000 USD plus commission . Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency. For this role, we’re prioritizing applicants with deep experience in the North American market and those who are available to work consistently in a North American time zone. We are seeking high-calibre candidates with the skills and qualities to make a net positive impact for Automattic . Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, exceed the stated range. This isn’t your typical work-from-home job—we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page and check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves. About Automattic Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind , WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place. We’re a distributed company with more than 1500 Automattic ians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world. observations.description: Supporting Cast seeks a passionate, creative developer with PHP and agentic engineering experience to expand onSupporting Cast’s podcast subscription platform. As a key member of our team, you'll be helping independent creators, podcast publishers, and media companies improve their financial sustainability and better satisfy their fans. You'll be joining a small development team and will be in a position to influence our tech stack and our evolving product. Working here provides the dynamic excitement of a startup, and the stability and competitive compensation of an established employer. We will consider candidates from anywhere in the United States, provided you can largely work East Coast hours—the role is fully remote. About the Position Opportunities: Learn a lot about the podcast industry and the rapidly growing paid subscription market Scale an application as we onboard clients with tens of thousands of members and evaluate new technologies Develop and maintain user- and administrator-facing features in our existing stack Help us leverage A.I. tools to accelerate new feature development and improve code quality and security Build and maintain implementations for other websites, including embeds and third-party integrations Our Current Tech Stack: App : PHP/Laravel, Nginx, Varnish, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker, React Dev ops : AWS, Fastly CDN Key business vendors and partners: Stripe, Spotify, Wordpress Key software vendors: Google Cloud Computing, AWS (SES/SNS/SMS), Anthropic Repo: GitHub Project management: Agile-oriented. Notion, Google Docs, Slack. Requirements 1–3 years of professional experience with PHP and a PHP framework such as Laravel 1–2 years of experience with LLM-based A.I. Familiarity with programming fundamentals and industry best practices; a CS degree is a plus but not required Willingness to adapt and learn on the job WHY JOIN SUPPORTING CAST? You’ll help make workplaces more connected, informed, and interesting via the magic of podcasting. Supporting Cast built one of podcasting’s first and most successful subscription management platforms for top public podcasters before expanding to improve employee experiences at some of the most interesting companies in the world. You’ll be the first hire for this function. This is a great opportunity if you want ownership of your work, a taste of startup life, and the responsibility of setting the bar high for a new team. You’ll also enjoy competitive salary and benefits in a remote-first, mission-driven, and family-friendly team. About Supporting Cast: Supporting Cast is a podcast monetization platform that helps top publishers and creators offer premium subscription content directly to listeners. Our clients include leading podcast publishers like NPR, SiriusXM, and NBC, along with major independent shows. A proponent of the open ecosystem, we make it seamless for subscribers to access premium podcast content in their favorite app—no new app to download—and give publishers the tools to grow and manage their paying audience with flexible integrations, analytics, and payments. We’re a small, fully remote company with a strong belief in the future of audio. We’re looking for someone who is thoughtful and detail-oriented to help us bring the magic of podcasting into more corporate settings. Supporting Cast is an affiliate of the Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC). GHC is a diversified holding company whose operations include educational services; home health and hospice care; television broadcasting, online, print, and local TV news; automotive dealerships; manufacturing; hospitality; and consumer internet companies. observations.description: Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. We unite popular brands such as Clubessential , foreUP , myFitApp , Vermont Systems , Momence , Exerp , and many more. Join our Golf& Club vertical as a Web Implementation Specialist to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve. The Web Implementation Specialist builds, configures, and reviews WordPress websites for foreUP customers. This role organizes and implements customer-provided content and assets while using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and technical troubleshooting skills to create responsive, accessible, and search-friendly websites. The specialist also completes pre-launch quality assurance, resolves website issues, applies SEO and WCAG best practices, documents findings, and collaborates with internal teams to deliver high-quality websites on schedule. Some of the things you'll do: Build and update WordPress websites using approved designs, templates, content, and brand standards. Create responsive page layouts, navigation, forms, and reusable components using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and working knowledge of JavaScript. Work with themes, child themes, page builders, custom fields, plugins, and WordPress settings beyond basic drag-and-drop tools. Migrate and organize website content while improving formatting, usability, SEO, internal linking, metadata, and accessibility. Troubleshoot website layout, styling, plugin, browser, mobile, hosting, performance, and integration issues. Complete website quality assurance across devices and browsers, including links, forms, navigation, redirects, tracking, and responsive layouts. Identify and correct common ADA/WCAG accessibility issues using automated scanning and manual testing. Apply SEO and GEO best practices, including page titles, headings, meta descriptions, image optimization, schema, redirects, and internal linking. Support the configuration and validation of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, conversion tracking, and approved integrations. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues, improve website performance, and deliver projects on schedule. Working arrangements: Fully Remote in United States of America: You can work fully remote in this position, provided you have eligible working rights in United States of America and do not require sponsorship. Qualifications What would make me a good candidate? We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do. You'll need: 3+ years of hands-on WordPress development, implementation, or technical website operations experience. A portfoliodemonstratingcomplete WordPress websites and technical customization beyond basic content entry or page-builder use. Strong knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3, with working knowledge of JavaScript, responsive design, browser compatibility, and code inspection. Experience configuring and troubleshooting WordPress themes, plugins, templates, and site settings. Practical knowledge of website accessibility and WCAG best practices, including experience resolving ADA-related accessibility issues. Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AI search optimization, including metadata, schema, internal linking, page speed, and mobile usability. Experience with website QA, responsive and browser testing, launch checklists, DNS, SSL, redirects, caching, backups, and deployments. Strong organizational and documentation skills with the ability to manage multiple website projects and deadlines. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor's degree in web development, Information Technology, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. It would be great if you also have: Experience with PHP, the WordPress template hierarchy, hooks, filters, and safe customization practices. Experience with WP Engine or another managed WordPress host, including staging, backups, caching, redirects, domains, and deployments. Experience using accessibility testing tools and familiarity with ADA, Section 508, and VPAT/ACR documentation. Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, structured data, and SEO/GEO tools. Familiarity with Git, WordPress security, performance optimization, Core Web Vitals, and plugin management. Experience supporting multi-site programs, agencies, SaaS customers, golf courses, hospitality, recreation, or membership-based organizations. At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. Values and Life at Xplor Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: Find a better way Do the right thing Say it straight Win together Own the outcome If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. Ready to apply? To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Got questions? You can email us at . Originally posted on Himalayas
