observations.description: About Presence Presence is the leading provider of teletherapy solutions for children with diverse needs. Our award-winning technology connects speech-language pathologists, school psychologists, occupational therapists, and mental health specialists to K-12 school districts nationwide. With a growing network of over 2,000 clinicians and more than 8 million teletherapy sessions delivered, we’re dedicated to ensuring every child has access to the support they need. At Presence , we embrace the benefits of being a remote-first company while recognizing the importance of in-person connection to advance our mission. We place a high value on “cameras on” engagement, schedule coordination, and cross-functional communication to stay connected while working in different places. Travel is also an important part of many roles, helping us build stronger relationships with our teams, clinicians, and school partners. The frequency will vary by role and responsibilities, but may include activities such as department offsites, team gatherings, and school or industry events. About the role: We’re looking for a Marketing Web Developer to join our team. Reporting to the Marketing Director and working closely with our Marketing and Creative teams, you’ll own the management and optimization of our website, keeping it secure, accessible, and user-friendly while growing our visibility across search and emerging AI search channels. You’ll own the full lifecycle of web pages and projects, from brief to launch, formulating web solutions that meet business goals and create engaging, user-friendly experiences. This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical execution and creative strategy, and offers the opportunity to leverage your technical expertise, creative insight, and strategic thinking to drive the success of our digital presence - all while contributing to a mission-driven organization that helps children with special needs. To stay connected, all employees commit to being available on-camera during our Core Working Hours (Monday - Friday, 12 - 5 p.m. ET) with standard business hours of 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. in your local time zone. For this role, up to 10% travel may be required to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. What will you do at Presence : Website Management & Development Own our WordPress website, including day-to-day operations, technical troubleshooting, and monthly maintenance Use website analytics to identify opportunities and implement UI/UX improvements that enhance accessibility, performance, and engagement. Work closely with the creative team during design discussions, offering technical guidance on feasibility, best practices, and adherence to global systems and standards. Translate Figma design systems and prototypes into responsive, production-ready builds Implement responsive design to ensure consistency and usability across devices and screen sizes. Integrate third-party tools, APIs, and analytics tracking in partnership with cross-functional teams. Website Project Management Own website projects end-to-end, from brief support through launch, with clear success metrics, stakeholder alignment, and QA along the way. Support larger project-based initiatives such as website migrations or redesigns, in collaboration with the Marketing Director and other stakeholders. AEO / SEO / GEO & Reporting Strategy Drive AEO / SEO / GEO strategy, expanding search and AI citation presence across channels, closing content gaps through research and audits, and implementing on-page best practices such as meta tags, headings, and structured data markup. Conduct keyword research and analysis to improve website visibility and search rankings. Partner with the content team to provide insights and recommendations for website content aligned with optimization strategies. Build automated reporting on web and search performance, monitor key metrics, and present insights and recommendations What we are looking for: 5+ years building and maintaining production websites, with substantial WordPress experience Strong hands-on Elementor (or comparable page builder) skill, plus solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript PHP and custom WordPress theme or plugin development Git and modern development workflows, ideally on WP Engine REST APIs and third-party integrations GA4 and Google Tag Manager (including event and data layer configuration) or similar tools for measuring and improving web and marketing performance Ability to build reports and dashboards, and clearly communicate findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders In-depth SEO knowledge and a track record of successful strategies, including AEO/GEO and AI search visibility Practical WCAG 2.2 knowledge and sound judgment about handling sensitive data Experience owning a production system as the responsible party, with clear patching and access practices Strong eye for design detail and consistency, with the ability to translate a Figma design file or system into a polished, on-brand page Self-directed, with strong prioritization across multiple projects Clear, proactive communication, comfortable taking remote direction from the Marketing Director and collaborating across teams Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to technical challenges What else you might bring: K-12, healthcare, or another regulated environment A migration or replatform under your belt CI/CD, A/B testing and experimentation What will help you succeed here: Our team is committed to shared principles of inclusivity. We engage with all stakeholders in a spirit of listening, learning, and broadening our perspectives. We commit to a growth mindset. We don’t use energy to explain why something can’t be done; we figure out how to make it happen. We are mission-driven. Our work helps more children with special needs receive the necessary support. We believe that our work is essential, meaningful, and urgent. We believe in data-driven decision-making, measuring outcomes, and iterative improvement. You seek creative, effective solutions and persist beyond the first answer to find what truly works You deliver high-quality work on time, and you proactively seek support or guidance when challenges arise How we support you: Comprehensive benefit plans, including medical with a High Deductible Plan and generous HSA contribution, plus dental and vision coverage In addition to 11 observed holidays, salaried team members have flexible paid time off and hourly team members accrue 15 days paid time off starting 401K savings plan with a discretionary company match $500 home office stipend Benefits package including company-paid life insurance, AD&D, Employee Assistance Program, and disability benefits Wellness programs with Headspace, Peloton and One Medical Paid parental and caregiving leave Professional Development opportunities - eligibility to apply for our scholarship program Collaborative, inclusive, and fun culture that is recognized as Great Place to Work certified Employee Resource Groups to promote shared community and belonging A meaningful and fulfilling opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help thousands of students unlock their full potential through access to high-quality special education services Opportunities to give back to your community, including volunteer time off and donation matching An employee’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. We aim to pay competitively for our size and industry. The annual base salary range for this role is $115,000.00 - $135,000.00 This job description is intended to outline the general scope, responsibilities, and qualifications of the role. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of all tasks, duties, or responsibilities that may be required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time, with or without notice, to meet the evolving needs of Presence . Presence is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship, now or in the future. observations.description: We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Business Operations Coordinator to keep the firm running well and to own the operating processes behind our executive team, our partner program and our business development data. This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. You will support the Managing Partner and other leaders, but you will also own areas of the business end to end. We want someone who notices what needs attention, closes the loop without being reminded, improves recurring processes and puts spare capacity to productive use. What you will own Executive scheduling and firm coordination Manage calendars for the Managing Partner and other members of leadership, anticipate conflicts and propose solutions. Arrange travel, expenses submission and in-person logistics for the Managing Partner and other leaders. Coordinate internal, client, prospect and software-partner meetings across multiple calendars, including client calendars when authorized. Schedule interviews for candidates advancing through our ATS and make the candidate experience responsive and professional. Set up Zoom and Teams meetings, prep sessions and materials. Book in-office days and meeting space through Regus or similar providers. Run regular check-ins with leadership, maintain action lists and follow up with owners so commitments do not disappear after a meeting. Partner program operations Maintain the operating record for each software partner agreement: deal registrations, referral submissions, commission and referral revenue tracking, certification requirements and renewal dates. Maintain relationship maps of partner sales and alliance contacts, including the accounts and territories each covers. Flag to leadership when representatives from different partners are working the same target account. Coordinate partner-facing logistics: portal access, co-marketing assets, joint meeting scheduling and follow-up. Salesforce and business development data Own Salesforce data quality: keep account and contact records current, find and fix stale or inconsistent data, and drive the right person to supply missing information. Enrich accounts and contacts from conversations, public sources and partner intelligence so that account history and context live in one place. Perform account and contact research and build target lists in support of the SDR and leadership. Set up and maintain outreach lists and sequences in Mailshake for the SDR and produce simple outreach activity reporting. Maintain the firm's purchased and subscribed data sources and recommend additions or corrections. Build productive working relationships with executive assistants at clients, prospects and partners. Onboarding, offboarding and systems Own administrative onboarding for new employees and associates: first-month schedule with the manager, introductions, accounts, licenses, access and basic firm information. Be the first point of contact for new people during their initial weeks. Administer licenses and user access across Google Workspace, Zoom, Lucid, Salesforce, our ATS, Mailshake and other SaaS tools; identify unused licenses; coordinate AWS and Amazon Business account administration with the responsible engineer. Maintain the firm's access and credential inventory in the approved password manager, enforce MFA on administrative accounts, and remove access within one business day of a departure or role change. Manage Zoom cloud recordings and verify storage and delete redundant copies. Maintain naming conventions, folder structures and short written procedures so records can be found by anyone. LinkedIn, website and external providers Publish LinkedIn posts from content supplied by leadership and marketing, and keep the company page consistent and professional. Make routine WordPress updates to the website and coordinate larger changes with outside resources. Coordinate external marketing, graphics, content and legal providers: hand off assignments clearly, track open work and route completed deliverables to the right person. Presentations, spreadsheets and meeting support Build and format client-ready PowerPoint presentations from content supplied by leadership and subject-matter experts. Build and maintain Excel trackers, lists and basic analyses using formulas, filters, lookups and pivot tables. Prepare agendas for key internal meetings; attend selected meetings, capture decisions and actions, and file them in the right system. Continuous improvement and learning Continuously evaluate recurring work and implement better ways to do it, including standardization, automation and appropriate use of GenAI tools within the firm's data-handling rules. Build working knowledge of the firm's data management and consulting business so that your context and judgment improve over time. When core administrative work is under control, move capacity to partner operations, CRM enrichment, research and process improvement without waiting to be asked. What we are looking for Several years of experience in business operations, executive support, professional-services administration, sales operations or a similarly broad coordination role, with a track record of staying long enough in prior roles to take real ownership. Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars and follow-up for executives or senior professionals. Exceptional organization and attention to detail; high responsiveness; a strong instinct to close the loop. A proactive operating style: you identify additional work, risks and improvements rather than wait to be assigned every task. Sound judgment about when to act, when to recommend and when a question genuinely needs an answer first. High integrity and discretion with confidential company, client, employee, partner and system information. A courteous, professional communication style, written and spoken, that sets a constructive tone with colleagues, candidates, clients, partners and providers. Solid PowerPoint and Excel skills. Experience with Salesforce or another CRM and a real appreciation for data quality and disciplined capture. Experience with Google Workspace and comfort learning and administering SaaS tools. Effective in a fully remote environment across countries and time zones, collaborating over Zoom, Teams and email. Curiosity, an interest in learning the data and consulting space, and a desire to become highly capable with GenAI tools. Comfortable with occasional travel or in-person meetings when there is a business reason. Helpful but not required Experience in consulting, professional services, technology, data management, legal, accounting or another client-service environment. Experience with ATS, WordPress, Zoom administration, LinkedIn company-page administration, Mailshake or similar tools. Experience supporting a software partner or channel program, or coordinating external vendors. Experience with prospect and account research. DataCatalyst is an equal opportunity employer. Employment is contingent on a background check conducted in accordance with applicable law. What Sets Us Apart At DataCatalyst, you’re not a cog in a machine—you’re a trusted partner. Our culture is defined by: Impact-driven work : Your insights and execution shape client strategy and operational clarity. Collaborative excellence : We value respectful disagreement, diverse perspectives, and direct communication built for speed and precision. Entrepreneurial, low-bureaucracy environment : We move fast, make decisions with limited information, and rely on resourcefulness and clarity. Accelerated growth : By working alongside veteran consultants on focused, high-impact projects, you'll sharpen expertise swiftly—taking ownership and growing as a revenue-driving member of the team. Quality of Life : With our fully remote, low-travel model, you can do challenging, high-impact work without sacrificing personal priorities. We believe great consulting doesn’t require endless flights or late nights—it requires focus, autonomy, and sustainable balance. Ready to Apply? If you’re detail-obsessed, client-centric, and excited by the idea of crafting data clarity from chaos, we’d love to talk. Come help us bring trusted, high-impact data solutions to enterprises across the globe—without sacrificing balance, autonomy, or growth. At DataCatalyst , we enable enterprises to transcend data disorder and gain clarity—fostering smarter, faster decision-making. Our veteran team of data management, governance, and monetization specialists brings, on average, 15 years of experience to each engagement, and we're proud of our 100% project success rate. We take a hands-on, pragmatic approach—eschewing large junior consultant rosters and sales layers in favor of lean, deeply skilled teams focused on generating real business value. Using our proprietary Accelerate methodology, we swiftly deploy high-quality data strategies, governance structures, and MDM implementations across industries like financial services, healthcare, manufacturing & distribution, retail, energy, and more. We embrace a fully remote, low-travel model , enabling sustainable work-life balance across time zones without compromising client delivery. With a flat organizational structure , open collaboration, and software engineering-inspired rigor—particularly strong documentation and technical discipline—we cultivate an environment where each individual makes a direct and visible impact. observations.description: Web Ops Lead Grandir Solutions | Remote, Full-Time | Reports to Head of Client Success About Grandir Grandir Solutions is a marketing agency built for home service contractors. Our HQ is in Madison, WI. We are one of the fastest growing marketing agencies in the United States. We are in need of a talented and speedy Web Ops Lead that acts fast, thinks like a marketer, and can oversee a high volume of new website builds and edits weekly. The Role Right now, website builds and edits move through a dev team with no dedicated owner. There's no structured QA before a site reaches a client, no ticketing system for edit requests, and no one translating what an account manager or client is actually asking for into something a developer can execute cleanly. Account managers have been left to catch what falls through (checking for broken forms, leftover placeholder text, and pages that don't reflect what was promised) on top of their actual job of managing client relationships. You'll be the person who owns that gap. You'll sit between our account managers and our development resources, translating requests into clear specs, running technical QA before anything ships, and building the systems and processes that don't exist yet. This is not a management role in the traditional sense (you won't be running performance reviews) but you will be the person developers and account managers both look to for direction on how work gets done (a manager of systems). What we're looking for is someone who can see a better way to manage this, help build it, then run it. What you'll own Technical QA on every site before it reaches a client: broken links, working contact forms routed correctly, mobile responsiveness, page structure, clean SEO fundamentals (titles, meta descriptions, headers, alt text), no leftover placeholder content Website briefs/handoffs: build the most efficient process to take website ideation to execution Managing the relationship with our development resources: setting expectations, tracking turnaround, and ongoing coaching to your team on how to improve speed and quality Helping build the ticketing/project system we don't have right now: edit requests come in as scattered Slack messages with no timeline and no visibility. You'll stand up a real intake and tracking process (we've recently adopted ClickUp, but we're open to what actually works) Reducing how much gets custom-built from scratch: helping us move toward a set of proven, pre-built site templates that speed up delivery and cut down on the endless revision cycles that come from fully custom builds Requirements gathering on premium custom builds: for clients paying for a fully custom site, you may sit in on scoping conversations so you know exactly what needs to be built Working knowledge of hosting and domain management: comfortable with DNS and hosting environments to help us gain more organization over where our clients' sites live This role is not client-facing day to day. Your work is with the internal team (account managers and developers). What you bring Hands-on WordPress and Elementor (or similar page builder) experience — you've built and maintained real sites, not just used WordPress casually Enough technical depth to know what good work looks like — you need to be able to tell when a developer's output is actually done right, including when reviewing AI-assisted work Working SEO knowledge — on-page fundamentals, and comfort advising on how to build out content for a page targeting a specific service and location Experience coordinating with a development team — writing specs precise enough to prevent any "lost in translation" problem, and pushing back on quality without damaging the relationship Relentless eye for QA — someone who doesn't just check boxes, but their stamp of approval carries serious weight Comfort building process from scratch — you'll be setting up systems that don't currently exist, not just operating inside ones that do The ability to communicate clearly with both non-technical account managers and technical developers — translating in both directions without losing precision FIO mentality (figure it out) — We often inherit sites from an unfamiliar CMS and have unique requests made by our clients Nice to have Experience at a marketing or digital agency, ideally serving small-to-midsize business clients Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows Background in a role that blended technical work with direct people interaction — client services, technical account management, or similar Formal SEO training and experience Why this role matters We've grown from a handful of clients to over 250 in under four years, and this is one of the last pieces of that growth we haven't built real infrastructure around. You'll be inheriting some real mess, that's the honest truth of it, but you'll also have real backing to fix it and build something from the ground up, not just maintain someone else's system. We're a team that takes pride in our craft. We're looking for someone who wants to bring that same standard to how we build and manage websites (and has fun while doing it). We consider candidates regardless of age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and any other consideration covered by federal, state and local laws. While this position is remote, we're looking for candidates that live in the U.S. This is to facilitate communication and coordination with internal teams and clients. Strategic smarts + technical expertise + artistic magic. Here, that's our not-so-secret sauce for cooking up marketing that doesn't just capture attention - it drives real business growth for our clients. We serve as guides and advisors to clients, navigating them through the complexities of the digital landscape. Our Creative team also plays the crucial role of storytellers, bringing narratives to life that resonate with audiences and drive meaningful engagement. At The Digital Ring , we describe ourselves as being "data-driven, human-focused"; while data and tech form the backbone of our marketing strategy, we never lose sight of the human element. observations.description: Digital Marketing Specialist — Lead Generation & Lifecycle Marketing Location: Remote – Latin America Type of Contract: Full-Time | Contract Salary Range: $2,000–$3,200 USD/month, commensurate with experience Language Requirements: English proficiency; ability to communicate directly with a U.S.-based leadership team Our client is seeking a skilled Digital Marketing Specialist with hands-on experience in local lead generation, paid search, SEO, and lifecycle marketing to join their growing team. You will play a key role in managing customer acquisition and retention across established brands while building repeatable marketing systems for new market launches. Your work will directly impact lead volume, booking profitability, customer retention, and revenue growth as their business expands into new markets. Key Responsibilities Manage and scale hyper-local Google Search and Local Services Ads (LSA) campaigns for existing markets and new market launches, optimizing keywords, ad copy, landing pages, budgets, CPA, and conversion rates. Track and report key performance indicators including CPL, CAC, ROAS, booking conversion rates , and overall lead-generation performance. Improve local organic visibility through Google Business Profile management, citation consistency, localized link building, geo-targeted landing pages, keyword research, technical SEO, and content optimization . Optimize content and local search strategies for emerging search surfaces, including Google AI Overviews and AI-driven recommendations , while implementing review-generation strategies to strengthen social proof. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, CRM reporting, UTM tracking, and split testing to identify pipeline bottlenecks and improve performance across new and established markets. Develop recurring-booking workflows and automated email/SMS lifecycle campaigns , including seasonal reactivation and win-back campaigns designed to convert one-time customers into long-term subscribers. Create repeatable templates, processes, and marketing playbooks that allow lifecycle and lead-generation programs to be efficiently deployed across each new market. Must-Have Qualifications 2–4+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience , ideally within local home services, home care, franchise networks, or multi-location B2C businesses. Proven experience directly managing and scaling profitable Google Ads budgets with a strong focus on local lead generation. Strong knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization, localized link building, schema markup, and technical SEO . Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, WordPress/CMS landing page builders, and basic HTML/CSS . Comfortable with UTM tracking, split testing, performance reporting, and translating marketing data into actionable insights . Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, build processes from the ground up, and support marketing programs across multiple markets. Self-motivated, highly organized, and effective in a 100% remote, asynchronous work environment , with availability for core hours overlapping with Central Time (Austin, TX). Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting multi-location or multi-brand B2C businesses within the services sector. Background in launching digital marketing programs for new geographic markets. Experience building automated customer lifecycle programs focused on recurring bookings, reactivation, and retention. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Job Opening Details: Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Bleeding Disorders News . A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities. All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position. Please note you MUST be a member of the ITP community -- patient preferred, but caregivers may apply for consideration in order to apply for this position. Responsibilities and Duties Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire. Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors. Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures. Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit. Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner. Complete training assigned by Bionews HR. Experience Required Prior experience with writing for an audience. At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with ITP. Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses. Experience Preferred Experience in being professionally edited for publication. Experienced in generating a blog or column. Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to ITP. Knowledge Required Fundamentals of how ITP works. Knowledge Preferred The content needs or wants of the ITP community. Skills Required A swift and independent learner of Internet technology. A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences. Time management. Advanced creative writing. Skills Preferred Experience in using WordPress for content creation. Experience with the Slack communication app. Abilities Required Internet access and use. Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities. Who is Bionews? Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information. Bionews Vision To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community. Bionews Purpose We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life. Values: R.A.R.E. RESPONSIBILITY ADVOCACY RELATIONSHIPS EMPOWERMENT Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About Measured Measured is a marketing measurement and optimization platform grounded in incrementality intelligence. Since 2017, enterprise brands have used Measured to understand the true incremental impact of their paid media investments and make better decisions about where to invest next. By combining incrementality experiments, media mix modeling, attribution data, and deep measurement expertise, Measured gives marketing teams credible evidence of what is driving business results and where opportunities exist to improve performance. At Measured , we equip every team member with best-in-class technology to fuel extraordinary outcomes. We expect our team to continuously evolve alongside these tools, using AI as a partner for momentum and innovation — raising the bar on everything we build. Our people own the final voice, judgment, and accountability behind every deliverable. The Role The Marketing Coordinator helps keep the marketing organization moving. This hands-on role supports execution across content, communications, revenue marketing, partner marketing, and other marketing initiatives by coordinating projects, maintaining calendars and workflows, publishing content, supporting campaigns, and keeping deadlines and deliverables on track. Requirements Key Responsibilities Marketing Coordination & Operations Coordinate projects across content, communications, revenue marketing, partner marketing, and other initiatives. Track deadlines, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables, proactively identifying anything that could slow execution. Coordinate across internal stakeholders, SMEs, freelancers, agencies, designers, and other contributors. Use approved AI tools to support marketing execution, including research, content production, project coordination, reporting, and workflow efficiency Content & Website Support Manage the content calendar and coordinate production timelines, contributor inputs, reviews, and approvals. Publish and update website content, including blogs, landing pages, resources, press coverage, and other web pages. Manage content launch requirements, including graphics, links, forms, metadata, tagging, and final review. Implement SEO/AEO recommendations and maintain existing website and content assets as needed. Social Media & Communications Execute organic social programs across Measured company channels Maintain the social calendar and schedule approved content around campaigns, launches, announcements, and events. Coordinate graphics, video, and other social formats with design resources. Support social amplification by executives, SMEs, employees, and leadership. Monitor LinkedIn and relevant media outlets for Measured , customer, partner, competitor, and industry activity. Reporting & Performance Tracking Maintain recurring marketing reports, dashboards, trackers, and campaign documentation. Gather and update performance data across content, social, web, PR, and other marketing activities. Help identify notable changes, ensure reporting accuracy, and document what has launched, what is performing, and what requires follow-up. Experience & Skills 2–4 years of marketing experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, technology, media, advertising, or a related industry. Experience coordinating multiple marketing projects, campaigns, or workflows. Experience managing and publishing website content through a CMS; WordPress experience preferred. Familiarity with LinkedIn, organic social publishing, SEO, and digital content best practices. Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work, with the judgment to write effective prompts, evaluate outputs, and refine results for accuracy, quality, and brand consistency. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and dashboards. Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in managing deadlines and follow-up. Comfortable balancing shifting priorities and working across multiple teams. Resourceful, collaborative, and able to operate independently day to day. Benefits Perks 100% Remote Competitive Total Rewards and flexible paid time off Opportunities to give back through Measured for Good Engaged, diverse, and curious culture Award-winning technology built by an agile, collaborative team Measured values curiosity, integrity, aiming for the extraordinary, customer obsession, and employee belonging. Measured promotes diversity and inclusivity in all forms, which helps to shape our company culture and industry leading products. Measured is committed to providing equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants, regardless of race, color, hairstyle, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other protected characteristics. observations.description: About Firegang Dental Marketing Firegang Dental Marketing is a digital marketing company headquartered in Spokane, Washington that has been in business for nearly 20 years. Our clients are primarily dentists, and our service packages include website design, paid ad management, SEO, analytics, copywriting, and more. A successful Ticket Support Specialist at Firegang partners with cross-departmental teams to fulfill website ticket requests for a diverse portfolio of dental clients through Teamwork Desk. This role sits at the intersection of technical execution and client service, ensuring requests are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule. The ideal candidate brings administrator-level WordPress experience, takes initiative without waiting to be asked, and is eager to learn our proprietary WordPress framework and in-house plugin suite. This is a full-time, remote position available to candidates located anywhere in the U.S. Standard hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in the applicant's time zone. Responsibilities of a Ticket Support Specialist: Fulfill website ticket requests for a diverse portfolio of dental clients through Teamwork Desk , completing work accurately and on schedule. Add, edit, and remove page content in WordPress at an administrator level. Upload, resize, and place images on live client websites, including alt text and accessibility best practices. Activate, deactivate, and configure a range of WordPress plugins as ticket requests require. Manage site environments in WP Engine , including restoring backups and pushing and pulling between development and production. Partner with cross-departmental teams to clarify requests, confirm scope, and escalate issues that require development support. Follow established internal file naming conventions and URL standards on every request. Learn and apply Firegang's proprietary WordPress framework and in-house plugin suite. Maintain accurate data within Teamwork Desk and complete assigned tickets by their due dates. Requirements: Administrator-level WordPress proficiency , with confidence adding, editing, and removing page content. Experience uploading and placing images on live websites. Working knowledge of HTML . Basic Photoshop skills, particularly image resizing within file size constraints. Familiarity with image alt text and accessibility best practices . Ability to follow established internal file naming conventions. Clear understanding of relative versus absolute URLs . Comfortable activating, deactivating, and configuring a range of WordPress plugins. Proven experience managing a high volume of support tickets . Experience with WP Engine , including restoring backups and pushing and pulling between development and production environments. A collaborative communicator who asks questions rather than guessing. Bonus Points For: Prior experience with Teamwork Desk or a comparable ticketing platform. Familiarity with dental services and terminology . Previous experience in a marketing agency environment. Basic video editing skills. Graphic design skills, including Figma . Hands-on development experience. Soft Skills: Initiative: Takes ownership of the queue and moves work forward without waiting to be asked. Communication: Asks good questions and confirms scope rather than guessing at intent. Attention to Detail: Committed to producing high-quality, error-free work on live client websites. Willingness to Learn: Eager to pick up proprietary tools, frameworks, and plugins. Independence: Works effectively on their own in a remote, high-volume environment. Teamwork: Collaborates well across departments to keep client requests moving. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Tickets resolved on time and error-free. Ticket volume handled and queue turnaround time. Data integrity maintained within internal systems (Teamwork Desk, Teamwork Projects). Adherence to internal file naming, URL, and accessibility standards. Benefits: $50,000-$55,000 PPO Health Benefits (medical/dental) 401K Option with matching Generous PTO and Holiday Schedule 100% Remote Work Life, AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance Equal Employment Opportunity We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Le « pourquoi » du rôle Portage CyberTech recherche un spécialiste du marketing de contenu talentueux pour nous aider à définir notre ton, à informer nos publics et à stimuler l'engagement sur l'ensemble de nos canaux numériques. observations.description: Job Opening Details: Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the myasthenia gravis (MG) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Myasthenia Gravis News. A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities. All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position. Please note you MUST be a member of the myasthenia gravis community -- caregiver preferred -- in order to apply for this position. Responsibilities and Duties Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire. Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors. Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures. Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit. Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner. Complete training assigned by Bionews HR. Experience Required Prior experience with writing for an audience. At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with MG. Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses. Experience Preferred Experience in being professionally edited for publication. Experienced in generating a blog or column. Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to MG. Knowledge Required Fundamentals of how MG works. Knowledge Preferred The content needs or wants of the MG community. Skills Required A swift and independent learner of Internet technology. A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences. Time management. Advanced creative writing. Skills Preferred Experience in using WordPress for content creation. Experience with the Slack communication app. Abilities Required Internet access and use. Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities. Who is Bionews? Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information. Bionews Vision To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community. Bionews Purpose We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life. observations.description: About the Role We are looking for a talented Web Designer / WordPress Developer to join a growing team supporting an Australian SaaS business. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong WordPress and Divi development skills with good visual design judgment . You will be responsible for taking supplied content, objectives, and direction and turning them into polished, modern, high-quality website pages. This is not a role where you will simply wait for detailed design instructions. We are looking for someone who can think like both a designer and developer , make sound design decisions, recommend improvements, and take ownership of the page-building process from concept through to completion. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and update website pages using WordPress and Divi . Translate supplied content and objectives into effective page structures, layouts, and visual flows. Create modern, professional, SaaS-style website sections and page designs. Make independent decisions around spacing, typography, imagery, hierarchy, calls to action, and overall user experience. Recommend improvements and better solutions rather than simply implementing instructions. Ensure websites are responsive and function effectively across desktop, tablet, and mobile . Maintain strong visual and structural consistency across the website. Implement ongoing website improvements as new features, content, and campaigns are released. Work directly with stakeholders to take concepts and content through to finished website pages. Follow existing brand guidelines while introducing appropriate design ideas and improvements. Perform website quality checks before publishing or handing pages over for review. Potentially support additional websites and brands as the business grows. What We're Looking For 3+ years of relevant experience in web design and/or WordPress development. Strong hands-on experience with WordPress . Strong hands-on experience with Divi . Good visual design judgment and a strong eye for detail. Solid understanding of website architecture, page hierarchy, spacing, typography, visual flow, and calls to action. Strong understanding of responsive web design across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Experience working on SaaS, technology, professional services, or other modern business websites is highly preferred. Ability to work from existing brand guidelines while still contributing creative ideas. Ability to independently turn content and objectives into polished, user-friendly web pages. Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to recommend a better approach when appropriate. Comfortable working with feedback and applying learnings across the broader website. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work. A portfolio demonstrating relevant WordPress, Divi, and responsive website projects . How You'll Work You will generally be provided with the content, purpose, and direction for a page rather than detailed instructions for every design element. You will be expected to use your expertise to determine: The most effective page structure and layout How information should flow throughout the page Which content should be visually prioritized Where imagery, graphics, or visual elements can strengthen the page How calls to action should be positioned and presented How the overall user experience can be improved How the page should adapt across different screen sizes We are looking for someone who can produce a strong first version with limited detailed correction , rather than someone who requires extensive step-by-step direction for every page. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means consistently delivering website pages that are: Visually polished and professional Well-structured and easy to navigate Consistent with the existing brand Responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile Built efficiently and accurately in WordPress and Divi Delivered on time Strong enough in the first version to minimize unnecessary revision rounds You will also be expected to communicate proactively, provide clear progress updates, and raise any blockers or concerns early. Opportunity to Grow The initial focus will be supporting the primary website of the business. As you demonstrate strong performance and take greater ownership, there is potential to support additional websites, brands, and digital projects within the broader business. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be more than a page builder and have a genuine impact on the design, quality, and ongoing development of multiple websites . Position Details Employment Type: Full-time, Independent Contractor Location: Remote – Philippines Work Hours: Australian business hours Start Date: ASAP Work Setup: Remote / Work from home Equipment: Own device (BYOD) Holiday Schedule: Australian holidays Benefits HMO coverage SIL / Christmas shutdown Bonuses Standard benefits package Opportunity to work with an Australian business Global team exposure Potential to support multiple brands and websites as the role grows Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Senior Software Engineer, MediaWiki Content Platform Team Summary The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a software engineer to join our team, reporting to engineering management. As a software engineer, you will be responsible for engineering software that supports our product user experiences. In this role, you will work in a fully-remote environment (with occasional travel for team, department, or organization events), where we value teamwork and a consensus-oriented approach. You get to write open source code for collaborative experiences supporting well over half a billion pages accessed per day, and you get to do it at a place that believes we're all more successful when everyone has a good work-life balance. On the Content Platform team, we work to support and evolve all things wikitext, the markup language behind Wikipedia. We aim to make wikitext easier to write, faster to parse, and less error-prone for humans. We also strive to support editing and content analysis tools with structured representations. We also maintain the web services associated with content rendering and transformation. In this role, you will work in a mostly-remote environment. To ensure there are enough opportunities to communicate, the preferred timezone for this candidate will be GMT-4 to GMT+2. You are responsible for: Designing and delivering improvements to Wikipedia's wikitext processing infrastructure, balancing user experience, performance, backwards compatibility, and maintainability Iterating on new features through collaboration with fellow engineers, product managers, designers, client teams, and community members Writing PHP and JavaScript which supports hundreds of world languages Creating and maintaining internet APIs with server scripting languages Instrumenting components to monitor feature and quality characteristics Leveraging caching and persistence technologies Skills and experience: 5+ years of related professional experience in software engineering Experience with one or more of: parser generators, interpreters, language runtimes, compilers, or bringing a language feature through a product cycle Demonstrated ability to own complex technical projects from problem definition through implementation and delivery, including making and communicating architectural decisions and navigating ambiguity Experience designing and maintaining reliable, performant software components used by other teams, products, or large numbers of users Strong engineering practices: you enjoy writing unit and integration tests, proactively addressing security and code review feedback, and balancing architectural tradeoffs Ability to work effectively across team and organizational boundaries, identify and resolve technical dependencies, and bring projects to completion with limited direction Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical quality of a team, through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, or direct mentorship Qualities that are important to us: A desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access An emphasis on communicating clearly in both synchronous and asynchronous channels Self motivated with an ability to navigate through ambiguity and bring a project to completion with limited direction Additionally, we'd love it if you have this: Familiarity with the HTML5 spec and DOM manipulation Expertise in Node.js and related technologies Familiarity with Wikipedia/wikitext/markdown editing or content management systems (e.g., MediaWiki, Drupal, WordPress). We grow and care for MediaWiki and Wikimedia specific services. MediaWiki is an open source, PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript web application that powers Wikipedia and other Wikimedia Foundation websites. It has been incrementally developed for many years to become a richly featured wiki engine and the basis for hundreds of extensions and skins, and has a vibrant volunteer community. A history of open source contribution Bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree in computer science, software engineering, or other STEM field (or equivalent certification) About the Wikimedia Foundation The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA. As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics. The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries * . Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$116,633 to US$181,243 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location. *Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following: US States : Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District) Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. ( *citizens/permanent residents only) We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements. All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process. If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885. observations.description: Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure. Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers. But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences , across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions. Our Solutions: → Actirise: the display tech designed for performance → FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes → Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks → Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution → Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology Behind Sparteo ’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising. Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe: FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025 The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo , we don’t settle, we act. We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results. We are data-obsessed : Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos. We think as one : Collective goals come before personal wins. We trade off : We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results. We solve problems : We own challenges and turn ideas into action. We say what we do : Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈 The Mission As the Product Manager UX Orchestration , you own the no-code configuration layer of the Actirise solution: the tools that let publishers activate ad formats, configure the video player, and set up the CMP/Paywall experience — without a single line of code. You are the guardian of a consistent, controlled self-serve experience across every surface: back-office, client-facing UI, native platform, and WordPress plugin alike. Your mission: make configuration effortless for publishers while keeping Actirise in control of what's truly self-serve versus internally managed — turning orchestration into a growth lever, not an operational bottleneck. Your key responsibilities: 1. No-Code Configuration Strategy Define which configuration flows are self-serve vs. internally-managed, and design the framework that governs that boundary. Own the roadmap for the tagging plan (ad format activation), enabling publishers to activate and manage formats without dev intervention. Continuously simplify configuration paths — remove friction, reduce support tickets, increase adoption of self-serve tools. 2. Player & Video Catalog Configuration Own the player template configuration experience: enable publishers to customize player behavior and appearance without engineering support. Design and evolve the video catalog management tools (upload, organization, metadata) to keep the catalog scalable and easy to maintain. 3. CMP / Paywall Template Configuration Own the CMP/Paywall template configuration layer to deliver an easy configuration experience that respects both constraints. Ensure publishers can configure consent/paywall templates consistently, regardless of the surface they use. 4. Cross-Surface Consistency Guarantee that the configuration experience is coherent whether accessed via back-office, client-facing platform, or the WordPress plugin. Ensure design system application to keep configuration UI patterns consistent across surfaces. Define and maintain clean data contracts and ACLs for every configuration action. 5. Agentic Exposure Apply an agentic-first principle to every configuration capability: whatever a publisher or an internal user can do through the UI must also be executable by an AI agent not just clickable in a screen. Continuously audit existing configuration flows to close the human/agent parity gap ("can an agent already do what a human can do here?") and prioritize closing the biggest gaps. 6. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the Sparteo Account squad to ensure configuration is part of a smooth time-to-activation journey. Coordinate with PM Engagement on shared UI/UX and compliance boundaries. Partner with Tech/Engineering to ship configuration tools that are reliable, fast, and scalable. The Profile We're Looking For We are looking for someone who is obsessed with simplicity and control at the same time — who believes a great configuration tool should feel invisible to the person using it. PM Expertise: 3+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally on self-serve platforms, admin/back-office tools, or no-code/configuration products. UX Sensibility: Strong instinct for simplifying complex configuration flows into intuitive, guided experiences. Comfortable partnering with design systems. Technical Literacy: Understanding of API-first design, WordPress plugin environments. You don't need to code, but you need to speak engineering's language. Systems Thinker: Able to design frameworks (self-serve vs. managed) rather than one-off features — you think in guardrails, permissions, and consistency across surfaces. Cross-Functional Operator: Comfortable working at the intersection of multiple squads where boundaries require coordination, not competition. Agentic Mindset : Naturally designs every capability with a dual interface in mind — human UI and agent-executable action. Understands agent tool-calling patterns and can define clean, well-scoped tool interfaces rather than exposing raw UI logic. AdTech / Video Culture: Familiarity with ad format activation, video players, or CMP/consent tooling is a strong plus. Communication: Excellent communication skills — you can align Tech, Design, and client-facing teams around a shared configuration vision. A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints . You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision Your mind set to share our adventure 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists. 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically. 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you. 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis. Benefits & Work Environment 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo , we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London. 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment. 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones. 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond. 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role. 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for. At Sparteo , we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Ready to join Team Sparteo ? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process! Here are the stages in our recruitment process Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team. Analytical and business logic tests Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager Taking up references Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting. A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities. Please note you MUST be a member of the porphyria community -- patient preferred, but caregivers may apply for consideration in order to apply for this position. Responsibilities and Duties Fulfill 2x monthly deadlines as agreed upon on hire. Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors. At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with porphyria. Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses. Experience Preferred Experience in being professionally edited for publication. Experienced in generating a blog or column. Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to porphyria. Knowledge Required Fundamentals of how porphyria works. Skills Preferred Experience in using WordPress for content creation. Experience with the Slack communication app. Abilities Required Internet access and use. Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities. Who is Bionews? Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information. Bionews Vision To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community. observations.description: International Diploma in Education (iDE) Technical Coordinator Location: Worldwide Organization Summary: The vision of Edify is to see Flourishing, Godly Nations, and we seek to accomplish this by improving and expanding sustainable Christ-centered education globally. Edify is a non-profit organization registered in the U.S. since 2009 and now has operations in 16 countries, including Burkina Faso, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El-Salvador, Ethiopia, Ghana, Guatemala, Kenya, Liberia, Nigeria, Panama, Peru, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, and Uganda. Edify serves low-fee independent Christ-centered schools through three primary avenues, including loans, training and education technology. Learn more at Location: Virtual, US or one of Edify Operating Countries above Start Date: 11/1/2026 Reports To:Global Curriculum and Assessment Manager Salary Range: Commensurate with experience and education and competitive with other nonprofits Work Environment: This position will be a full-time remote position. The atmosphere of Edify is one where you can expect to perform widely varied tasks with various functional groups. There will also be collaboration with Edify ’s global team in the other countries where Edify operates, and with partner organizations and individuals that are part of the iDE program. Travel Expectations: Regular travel is not expected for this position. Edify holds an annual all-staff meeting, alternating in a US-based or international location each year. All Edify Staff are required to attend this meeting. Job Summary: The International Diploma in Education (iDE) program at Edify leverages online learning to train teachers at its partner schools. It uses three integrated systems to register (registration portal using Woo Commerce on Wordpress), train (TalentLMS), and communicate/track (Salesforce) progress throughout the lifecycle of each cohort. Multiple cohorts are run concurrently across different countries over the course of a year, with thousands of participants. The primary role of this iDE Technical Coordinator position is to ensure data quality across the systems. Zapier is used to move data between systems, and Salesforce Flow is also used to perform more complex updates in Salesforce. There are also automated weekly reports in Salesforce, and quarterly end-of-term grades that must be sent out. The iDE Technical Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the program runs smoothly, which heavily involves troubleshooting and diagnosing issues as they arise. Central to this role is managing and optimizing cross-platform integrations, automations, and data syncs to ensure seamless technical operations. This role will also supplement work in these areas as assigned by leadership. Duties/Responsibilities: Each iDE cohort must be supported through the different stages of its lifecycle. Because there are multiple cohorts running across different countries on different timelines, these stages may overlap between cohorts. Registration Create cohort branches in TalentLMS with admins for each one Setup school for registration in TalentLMS and Salesforce Create teacher and facilitator groups for each cohort Setup the cohort in the Registration Portal (Wordpress) set the cost and registration period update the registration form (WPForms) update the payment methods (country-specific) test entire process well in advance of open registration period Enroll schools in the cohort in Salesforce Assign appropriate Salesforce permissions to in-country leads for each cohort Troubleshooting registration issues with registrants Inability to register (registration dates, school permissions, OTP WhatsApp or Email issues). Inability to pay (payment gateway errors) Troubleshooting system integration issues (data synchronization) Create and update FAQ page for each new cohort, receiving input from in-country leads on areas of need and learning Import courses to Salesforce Cohort Support Create weekly progress reports in Salesforce and check for errors Release course reports and results via TalentLMS user fields Export end-of-term results to Salesforce Troubleshoot synchronization issues between TalentLMS and Salesforce Develop scalable automation to identify synchronization issues Perform manual updates as necessary to support exceptional circumstances Meet with iDE team Collaborate with Edify HR & IT Teams regarding impacts to TalentLMS and/or Salesforce End of Term/Cohort Create reports on end-of-term scores and review with iDE team for discrepancies Coordinate sharing of term results with teachers (via WhatsApp, Salesforce, or TalentLMS) Deactivate cohorts in Salesforce and delete branches in TalentLMS General Systems Support Quality assurance of courses in our LMS system Data quality analysis Troubleshoot systems automation Required Skills/Abilities: Personal values that align to Edify ’s mission. Living example of servant leadership. Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written, verbal and technology-based communication skills. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. Course design in an LMS system. Strong cross-cultural collaboration and communication skills. Systems Knowledge Required: Required LMS (TalentLMS preferred but not required) Salesforce Flow Wordpress Zapier or similar workflow integration platform Woo Commerce Preferred PHP Linux MySQL Education and Experience: B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Two years of experience in the IT Field working in systems integration Additional Information: Applications will be accepted for this position through September 30. observations.description: As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) on the Automattic Special Projects team, your primary responsibility will be to ensure our partners have an excellent experience with WordPress and Automattic products, from initial partner onboarding through the entire support and maintenance lifecycle of a website. Your role involves close collaboration with site owners, designers, and developers to actualize partner requests, while also providing valuable feedback for product improvement to Automattic ’s teams. Your key responsibilities will include: Driving our partners’ adoption of WordPress and other Automattic products and services. Working closely with our partners to resolve their incoming requests with high precision. Drawing on your technical acumen and verbal and written communication skills to represent Automattic . Collaborate with partners to define website functionality in ambiguous contexts, and take ownership of delivery, timelines, and outcomes. Diving into WordPress and WooCommerce configurations, setup, and site building. Leading high-touch deployments or launches, including DNS configuration, domain transfers, data migrations, and integrations. Acting as the “voice of the customer” for our product teams, championing areas for opportunity, and surfacing bugs. Other responsibilities: Developing close relationships with our partners in order to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from our products—particularly (but not limited to) WordPress, WooCommerce, Jetpack, and MailPoet. Troubleshooting technical and editor-facing issues as they arise, resolving the root causes where possible, and liaising with engineers where more in-depth support is needed. Translating partner requests into concrete, WordPress-focused requirements. Writing up clear, detailed tasks for team members to execute. Responding to urgent incidents on our partner sites (such as fatal errors or workflow-blocking bugs) with speed, care, and attention to detail. Continuously looking to improve and share processes that increase active project capacity. Communicating confidently with third parties about partner needs, integration requirements, and WordPress best practices. Demonstrating ownership of the quality of our partners’ sites by advocating for their needs, verifying solutions we've delivered, and having a high attention to detail.
